You will build flexible analytical applications with an open-source Python stack and deploy them on Tonik's internal web server in partnership with IT.The priority is to give Risk, DS and business teams timely visibility into scorecard performance, data coverage and operational issues. Deliver clear navigation, filters, drilldowns and export capabilities for internal users.Develop a reusable monitoring framework so new or refreshed scorecards can be onboarded quickly. Target operational dashboards within one week of model go-live, with outcome-based measures becoming available as repayment cohorts mature.Implement monitoring views for underwriting, behavioural and offer scores, collections, payroll-backed lending and other assigned models. Support component and stacked-score views, product segments and model-version comparisons.Work with DS and Risk to define and implement Gini, KS, PSI, CSI, calibration, deciles, approval rates and bad rates. Capture agreed cohort, numerator, denominator and outcome-maturity rules rather than hard-coding ambiguous definitions.Separate input and score monitoring available at launch from performance metrics that require matured outcomes. Clearly label reporting windows, sample sizes, data freshness and insufficient-data conditions.Connect to BigQuery and approved data sources using efficient SQL and reusable data-access layers. Use pre-aggregation, caching and controlled refreshes to keep dashboards responsive and query costs manageable.Build visibility into partner coverage, missingness, API failures and score-range changes. Implement agreed threshold alerts and exception views with enough detail for teams to investigate.Deploy and maintain dashboards on the internal web server with IT, including service configuration, dependencies, logging and health checks. Integrate enterprise authentication and appropriate access controls for sensitive lending data.Reconcile dashboard results to independently checked SQL or DS calculations. Use tests, code review and user acceptance testing to prevent misleading metrics, filter behaviour or exports.Use approved AI coding tools where useful; review generated code and validate logic before release. Maintain version control, technical documentation and a prioritized backlog with users.Migrate and retire legacy BI (Power BI) dashboards as the Python stack matures, so refresh cycles are no longer constrained by the old setup.Required Experience and Qualifications:2 to 5 years of relevant Python dashboard, analytical application or web development experience, with examples of applications deployed for business users.A bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, data analytics or a related discipline, or equivalent practical development experience.Strong Python and SQL skills, including pandas and experience building interactive applications with Dash and Plotly or a comparable Python web framework.Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, responsive layouts, callback or application state management, APIs and debugging web applications.Experience connecting dashboards to databases, validating calculated metrics, managing performance and maintaining production applications.Practical knowledge of Git, testing, Linux-based deployment, authentication and authorization. Ability to work with IT on secure internal hosting.Ability to clarify business metric definitions, present data accurately and collaborate with analysts, Data Scientists and Risk users.Preferred Experience and Qualifications:Prior lending or credit risk scorecard monitoring experience, including Gini, KS, PSI, CSI, vintage analysis, deciles and matured bad-rate reporting.Experience with GCP and BigQuery, query optimization, caching, scheduled data refreshes and monitoring multiple model versions.Experience with enterprise SSO, role-based access, Docker, reverse proxies or deployment through CI/CD.Experience using AI-assisted development productively while retaining code review, tests, data protection and calculation validation.What Success Looks Like:A reusable dashboard framework makes monitoring available quickly after go-live and supports frequent scorecard refreshes.Metrics reconcile to agreed definitions, with clear maturity, freshness and sample-size information.Dashboards remain responsive, secure and useful for identifying degradation and directing investigation.Who are we looking for?We value teamwork, honesty, reliability, practical problem-solving and a sense of humour. You take ownership of your work, communicate early when something is wrong, and challenge assumptions respectfully. You are comfortable collaborating across locations and improving how the team works.Willingness to go the extra mile for success.Energetic and lively, and street smart.As our approach to banking is far from ordinary, we are looking for an innovative and creative individual to join our team.Above all, a great team player and proactive communicator. This is a table-stake criterion.About Tonik:We are a transformative digital bank with a mission to revolutionize the way money works. We create better financial products for the world by encouraging inclusivity through simplifying processes, reducing costs, improving transparency, and embracing flexibility to empower more people with unique financial needs. All these are on the most secure mobile banking platform. To enable this, innovation is woven into the DNA of our company. We do not just search for the best talent, but for people who seek to challenge the status quo and are passionate about transforming the impossible into reality.Tonik (www.tonikbank.com) is the first digital-only neo bank in the Philippines, providing loan, deposit, payment, and card products to consumers on a highly secure digital banking platform. The neo bank operates based on the first private digital bank license issued by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas. Tonik is led by a team of retail finance veterans who have previously built and scaled multiple retail banks and fintechs across the global emerging markets. It is backed by top international venture capital funds. Tonik operates out of hubs in Singapore (HQ), Manila, Chennai, and Kyiv.Our Data team works with Risk, Product, Technology and business teams to improve lending decisions and customer outcomes through reliable data, analytics and machine learning.

title: Software Development Engineer - 3
description:
AssetPlus is redefining the future of wealth management. We're a fast-scaling SaaS fintech platform powering mutual fund distributors (MFDs) and financial advisors with tools that modernise how investments are managed. Our mission is to build India's best assisted wealth management platform, helping millions of households achieve their financial goals.
  
  
Engineering at AssetPlus is a growth led, high-velocity team of ~18 engineers organized into three product pods. We ship on a modern, AI-enabled Node.js + TypeScript + MongoDB stack, own our systems in production, and hold a high technical and cultural bar. If you want to solve meaningful problems at scale with real ownership, this is the place.
  
  
**The Role**
We are looking for a deeply hands-on SDE-3 who owns features end-to-end and raises the quality bar within a pod. You bring strong technical judgment, speed, clarity and simplicity to everything you build. You will be a core builder inside one product pod: designing services, writing production Node.js + TypeScript, shaping MongoDB schemas, debugging across backend, React and Flutter, and keeping the systems you own reliable. You will use AI as a cognitive partner to move faster without lowering the bar.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Architecture & Systems**

* Design and build scalable, resilient services within your pod's domain.
* Contribute to system design reviews and argue trade-offs with first-principles reasoning.
* Decide what to build vs reuse vs adopt open-source, and explain the call.
* Follow and strengthen the architecture patterns the team has agreed on.

**Hands-On Engineering**

* Write high-quality Node.js + TypeScript code - readable, tested, production-grade.
* Design efficient MongoDB schemas and build complex aggregations.
* Debug issues across React, Flutter and Backend, down to the infra and DB layer.
* Leverage AI capabilities and develop at a high pace with good taste.

**AI Driven Engineering**

* Use AI as a cognitive partner to accelerate coding, debugging, design and decision-making.
* Orchestrate models, tools, context and workflows into a productive AI-powered engineering loop.
* Continuously adopt new AI capabilities to compound speed and improve system quality.
* Bring AI native practices into your pod's day-to-day workflow.

**Reliability & Support**

* Monitor the systems you own and catch issues early.
* Respond to critical incidents with urgency - including off-hours when it matters.
* Drive root-cause analysis, performance improvements and observability.

**Developer Experience & Quality**

* Contribute to improving developer workflows, tooling and automation.
* Maintain high standards around clarity, testing, security and simplicity.
* Advocate for minimal, robust and maintainable engineering.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Mentor junior and mid-level engineers and review their work closely.
* Communicate decisions clearly and confidently.
* Be approachable, energetic and easy to build with.

**What we are looking for;**
Must have
  
  

* 6–8 years of full stack experience with a backend-heavy core (experience range is indicative - we hire for ownership, not tenure)
* Strong Node.js + TypeScript in production; you have owned services end-to-end, not just contributed
* Solid MongoDB - schema design, indexing, complex aggregations
* Built and operated systems under real load; comfortable being on the hook when they break
* Strong debugging across backend, frontend and DB layer
* Pragmatic engineering judgment - simple > clever; sound build vs reuse vs open-source calls
* Strong communicator - can clearly explain a system you owned and the decisions behind it

**Strongly Preferred**

* Hands-on AWS - CloudWatch, ECS, Amplify, Lambda, SQS, SES
* React and/or Flutter exposure - enough to debug across the stack
* Fintech, wealth-tech or SEBI-regulated product experience
* Daily use of AI coding tools as a real productivity multiplier, not a novelty
* Experience mentoring juniors and running meaningful code reviews
* CI/CD, Docker and GitHub-based workflows in a fast-shipping team

title: Finacle Product Engineer | CMS & API Integration (Banking)
description:
**Job Summary**
Synechron is seeking a seasoned Finacle Product Engineer to lead the design, customization, integration, and support of Finacle-based banking solutions. This role combines domain expertise in Finacle with hands-on scripting, API development, and stakeholder collaboration to deliver end-to-end enterprise capabilities. The ideal candidate will drive enhancements across CMS/customization layers, ensure quality and compliance, and partner with cross-functional teams to meet business objectives in a regulated banking environment.
  
  
**Software Requirements**
**Required Skills (Essential)**

* Strong hands-on experience with Finacle Core Banking, including Finacle scripting and knowledge of card processing domains
* Proficiency in Finacle customization and integration points (APIs, Finacle Integrator, and related interfaces)
* Experience with REST APIs and architecture for core banking integrations
* Solid knowledge of SQL and data modeling for banking data, including data validation and ETL considerations
* Experience working in Agile environments and participating in cross-functional ceremonies
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills to interact with business units across locations

**Preferred Skills**

* Finacle certification from Infosys or equivalent vendor-specific credentials
* Experience with banking compliance and audit readiness in technology work
* Familiarity with modern DevOps practices, CI/CD, and release management
* Exposure to cloud deployments (AWS/Azure/GCP) in banking contexts
* Knowledge of advanced testing and validation approaches for core banking suites

**Overall Responsibilities**

* Lead the customization, integration, and ongoing support of Finacle-based solutions across multiple business units
* Design technical specifications, architecture diagrams, and implementation plans for new features and enhancements
* Collaborate with business analysts, developers, QA, and operations teams to capture requirements and deliver end-to-end solutions
* Ensure code quality, maintainability, and adherence to development standards across projects
* Participate in code and design reviews, mentoring junior engineers, and promoting best practices
* Manage vendor interactions, project timelines, and risk mitigation strategies
* Stay current with Finacle releases, banking technology trends, and regulatory changes to inform backlog and roadmap decisions
* Support data governance, security controls, and audit readiness within Finacle-related implementations
* Document configurations, integration points, and operational procedures for ongoing support

**Technical Skills (By Category)**
**Programming Languages (required and preferred)**

* Essential: Finacle scripting language (domain-specific scripting for customization)
* Preferred: Java or other general-purpose languages used for integration or tooling

**Databases/Data Management**

* Essential: SQL and data modeling for banking data; data validation practices
* Preferred: NoSQL familiarity and data warehousing concepts (e.g., star/snowflake schemas)

**Cloud Technologies**

* Preferred: Cloud deployment experience (AWS, Azure, GCP) in banking contexts
* Essential: Understanding of cloud concepts and secure deployment considerations

**Frameworks and Libraries**

* Essential: Finacle customization frameworks and APIs; REST API development patterns
* Preferred: API integration patterns, middleware interfaces, and enterprise integration frameworks

**Development Tools and Methodologies**

* Essential: Agile/Scrum practices; Jira/Confluence; version control (Git)
* Preferred: CI/CD tooling experience (Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions), test automation

**Security Protocols**

* Essential: Data privacy, secure coding practices, and access control basics
* Preferred: Banking-grade security controls, encryption concepts, and regulatory compliance awareness

**Experience Requirements**

* 7-12 years of experience working with Finacle in architecture, customization, or integration roles
* Proven track record delivering Finacle-based projects in a banking context
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams across multiple locations
* Willingness to engage in continuous learning about Finacle updates and banking technology trends
* Alternative pathways: substantial hands-on Finacle CMS customization projects or relevant certifications

**Day-to-Day Activities**

* Analyze business requirements and translate them into Finacle customization and integration work
* Design and implement changes across CMS modules, interfaces, and APIs
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, QA, and operations to ensure smooth deployments
* Review code and design artifacts; participate in architecture discussions
* Troubleshoot production issues and drive timely resolutions
* Maintain documentation for configurations, processes, and change control
* Mentor junior team members and contribute to knowledge sharing

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
* Finacle-related experience and domain knowledge in banking/card services are highly valued
* Certifications in Finacle, banking technology, or related disciplines are a plus
* Commitment to ongoing professional development in banking technology solutions

**Professional Competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
* Clear communication and stakeholder management for technical and business audiences
* Leadership and mentorship abilities for cross-functional teams
* Adaptability to evolving banking technologies and regulatory requirements
* Strategic thinking with a focus on scalable, compliant solutions

Responsible for creating/maintaining functional specifications for WRICEF (Workflow, Report, Interface, Conversion, Enhancement, Forms) objects. Perform configuration, testing, training, migration, cutover, go-live and hyper care activities. Support incidents or change requests for the live Business units. Minimum 2 full lifecycle implementations / roll outs & support experience in BRIM module in S/4 HANA projects with related modules SOM, CI, CC and FI-CA. Hands-on experience in configuring BRIM components and managing end-to-end billing cycles. Understanding on SAP Best Practices in BRIM and SD modules and their integrations & technology. Experience in S/4HANA environment and Fiori applications. Strong communication skills in English, self-driven and motivated. Ability to manage and deliver multiple priorities in a constrained timeline Desirable: SAP S/4 HANA Certification in SAP BRIM. Ericsson is looking for a highly motivated Senior Solution Integrator with 4–5 years of experience in Telecom BSS (Order Care/EOC, Billing, and Charging) and a strong background in large-scale data migration and transformation programs. title: Software Development Engineer
description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**
We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.
  
  
**About The Team**
VNDLY, a Workday company, is a next-generation vendor management SaaS platform designed for procurement executives, talent acquisition teams, suppliers, and Managed Service Providers (MSPs) to optimize contingent workforce management. We develop cloud software that simplifies talent sourcing and acquisition across various channels, including staffing agencies, job boards, and freelance management systems. Our aim is to create intuitive software that enables customers to efficiently acquire top talent (contractors or full-time employees) through data-driven insights and transparent dashboards.
  
  
As part of Workday, we are committed to becoming the most customer-centric enterprise software company in the world. We prioritize enabling our customers to connect to the talent they need to excel, achieved by fostering an exceptional engineering team committed to code quality and innovative design.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Software Development Engineer, you will be joining a team in Chennai responsible for maintaining and building our pay-related features. This is a hands-on-keyboard role where you will not only build features but also own the design, scalability, and resilience of critical services.
  
  
You will tackle complex challenges related to how contingent workers are onboarded, managed, and paid, working on key features like Jobs, Worker Provisioning, Contracts, and Integrations. You will be a key voice in our architectural decisions and will guide the team in building robust solutions using our stack: Python (backend), React (frontend), and AWS.
  
  
**About You**
This role is for an experienced engineer who enjoys solving complex software problems. The ideal candidate will join an established office of 15 VNDLY colleagues and will be at the forefront of building our engineering presence as part of Workday's larger investment in Chennai!
  
  
Beyond a desire for solving complex and writing high-quality, efficient code, this person must be an exceptional communicator, acting as a key technical connection between our established U.S. teams and the new Chennai office. The ability to work independently, while also working effectively within a large, distributed team, is essential.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 4+ years shown experience in software development, including experience in designing, building, and maintaining RESTful web services and working with SQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL).
* Deep proficiency in Python and experience with at least one Python web framework (e.g., Django, Flask).
* Strong experience with JavaScript frameworks, specifically React.js.

**Other Qualifications**

* Proficient understanding of code versioning tools (e.g., Git).
* Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) (e.g., EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda).
* Knowledge of SaaS applications, multi-tenant architectures, and DevOps/CI/CD practices.
* Experience working in an Agile/Scrum development environment.

Workday is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.
  
  
Further, pursuant to applicable local ordinances, Workday will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
  
  
You may view the Workday's Pay Transparency Policy, and Equal Employment Opportunity is the Law notice, by clicking on their corresponding links.
  
  
Workday is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans during our application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, contact us at accommodations@workday.com.
  
  
**Our Approach to Flexible Work**
With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply
**spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field**
with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.
  
  
Workday is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals during our application process, in order to perform one or more essential functions of their job, as well as regarding the use of AI tools for employment decision-making to any degree. Please see below for more details including how to request an accommodation as a qualified veteran, due to a disability or for religious reasons, or as otherwise provided under applicable law.

Any employee who retaliates against a candidate or employee for doing so may be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment, to the fullest extent allowable under applicable law.
  
  
If you require a reasonable accommodation, you may email accommodations@workday.com, as far in advance as possible.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEER
  
  
**Location: Chennai | Type: Fulltime**
**About Newpage Solutions**
Newpage Solutions is a global digital health innovation company helping people live longer, healthier lives. We partner with life sciences organisations which include, pharmaceutical, biotech and healthcare leaders, to build transformative AI and data driven technologies addressing real-world health challenges.
  
  
From strategy and research to UX design and agile development, we deliver and validate impactful solutions using lean, human-centered practices.
  
  
We are proud to be a Great Place to Work certified company for the last three consecutive years. We also hold a top Glassdoor rating and are named among the "Top 50 Most Promising Healthcare Solution Providers" by CIOReview. As an organisation, we foster creativity, continuous learning and inclusivity, creating an environment where bold ideas thrive and make a measurable difference in people s lives.
  
  
**Your Mission**
We are hiring Forward Deployed Engineers who treat AI as the substrate of how software gets built not a tool to be cautious of, not something they are "exploring," but the medium they work in.
  
  
You will sit close to clients and product leaders, reframe vague problems into something concrete, and ship working software end-to-end. You won't wait for a refined backlog, a PM in the middle, or a separate platform team. You will shape the idea, build the thing, and stand it up in production yourself.
  
  
This is a builder-first individual-contributor role for engineers who live at the current edge of AI development and work fluently with Claude Code, Cursor, agents, eval harnesses, MCP, and modern TypeScript and Python.
  
  
**What You Ll Do**
**Problem / Opportunity Discovery**

* Sit with a business or clinical leader and reframe an idea or problem into something concrete and buildable.
* Know what to build by the end of the conversation; have a working prototype to react to by the end of the week.
* Partner closely with product, design, and client stakeholders to translate ambiguous ideas into software that ships.
* Demo live without a slide deck. Reframe problems out loud. Don't get stuck waiting for someone else to make the decision.
* Lead POCs, innovation sprints, and internal research experiments to validate emerging AI techniques.

**Build (fast) with AI**

* When the brief is clear, head down and produce.
* Build modular backends in Python or TypeScript aligned with clean architecture, OOP, SOLID, and domain-driven design.
* Create fullstack applications, APIs, agents, workflows, and similar systems using frameworks such as Next.js, React, FastAPI, Fastify, FastMCP, and Hono.
* Architect and ship production-grade agentic applications using LangGraph, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants, or your own orchestration layer.
* Integrate frontier and self-hosted LLMs (Claude, GPT, Gemini, open-weight models) with tools, data, and external systems through MCP and custom connectors.
* Apply RAG techniques where they actually help: vector databases (Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, pgvector), hybrid retrieval with ElasticSearch or Solr, and BM25 + similarity search.
* Work across relational, document, key-value, and graph stores as the problem demands; use event-driven patterns where they fit, not by default.
* Design prompt and context engineering frameworks that optimize accuracy, repeatability, cost, and latency.
* Use AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Codex) through structured workflows, native instructions, templates, and sub-agents with discipline and review.
* Fine-tune or adapt models where the problem genuinely calls for it.

**Test, Deploy, Productionize**

* Spin up the infra, write the evals, wire up the MCP servers, deploy the agents, and harden the bits that survive contact with real users.
* Deploy on AWS, Azure, Cloudflare, or Vercel using containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) or serverless chosen for fit, not preference.
* Treat evals as a first-class discipline: hands-on harnesses, not theoretical frameworks. Build with a clear-eyed view of where current AI tooling helps and where it falls short.
* Apply engineering practices that hold up in production: TDD, secrets management and rotation, SAST/DAST, structured logging, metrics, tracing, and automated CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins).
* Own what you build end-to-end, including the infrastructure and operations that keep it running.
* Mentor others on system design, agentic patterns, and AI engineering best practices.

**What You Bring**

* Minimum 7+years of Experience and 3+ years relevant experience building production applications using AI / agentic development approaches fullstack applications, agents, workflows, MCPs, and more.
* Hands-on experience with agents, not just prompted models. You have wired tools to a model and let it run multi-step using LangGraph, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants, or your own orchestration.
* Active, structured use of AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) with demonstrable workflows, sub-agents, skills, and innovative approaches.
* Strong Python or TypeScript, with OOP, SOLID, 12-factor application development, and microservice architecture. You've built Next.js applications, FastAPI services, and similar.
* End-to-end implementation experience with vector databases, retrieval pipelines, and eval harnesses.
* Cloud-native deployment experience across at least one of AWS, Azure, Cloudflare, or Vercel with Docker, Kubernetes, and GitHub Actions.
* A no-compromise attitude on clean code, TDD, security, observability, scalability, performance, and cost.
* A deep working understanding of how LLMs behave and where they break and how to optimize accuracy, latency, and cost.
* Clear writing and a willingness to reframe problems in conversation rather than wait for someone else to define them.
* A real, recent trail of built things: GitHub, a portfolio, side projects, indie tools, or OSS contributions.
* A founder's mindset and genuine appetite for ambiguous, high-impact technical challenges.
* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related technical discipline.

**Bonus Skills / Experience**

* Public writing, talks, or threads about building with AI.
* MLOps and model serving experience (BentoML, MLflow, Vertex AI, SageMaker).
* Streaming and batch ingestion pipelines (Spark, Airflow, Beam, Glue).
* Healthcare or life sciences domain exposure.
* AWS Professional certification or other relevant industry certifications.

**What We Offer**
At Newpage, we re building a company that works smart and grows with agility, where driven individuals come together to do work that matters. We offer:
  
  

* A people-first culture - Supportive peers, open communication and a strong sense of belonging
* Smart, purposeful collaboration - Work with talented colleagues to create technologies that solve meaningful business challenges
* Balance that lasts - We respect your time and support a healthy integration of work and life
* Room to grow - Opportunities for learning, leadership and career development, shaped around you
* Meaningful rewards - Competitive compensation that recognises both contribution and potential

**Ready to Apply?**
Let s build the future of health together. Apply below or reach out to:
  
  
ramadevi.bhumireddy@newpage.io

You will collaborate with product, UX, data engineering, and AI/ML teams and help establish engineering standards through design reviews, code reviews, and technical mentoring.
  
  
As a Platform Engineer, you will balance hands-on architecture and coding with technical mentorship, driving engineering standards, MLOps best practices, Platform reliability, and cross-team alignment.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Full-Stack Platform Engineering
* Design and develop responsive, accessible, and maintainable platform user interfaces using Angular, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Build secure, scalable microservices and REST APIs using Java and Spring Boot, with clear contracts between frontend and backend components.
* Own features end to end, including solution design, coding, automated testing, deployment, production monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
* Conduct design and code reviews, establish reusable engineering patterns, and mentor engineers on full-stack and cloud-native development practices.
* GCP Platform Architecture & Engineering
* Design cloud-native solutions on GCP using services such as Cloud Run, Google Kubernetes Engine, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks, Workflows, Cloud Scheduler, API management, and load balancing.
* Engineer data and application integrations using Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, BigQuery, Secret Manager, IAM, networking, logging, monitoring, and security controls.
* Build resilient, observable, and cost-efficient services with appropriate scaling, fault tolerance, retry, disaster recovery, and performance patterns.
* AI-Enabled Platform Capabilities
* Integrate current AI and generative AI capabilities into platform workflows using Vertex AI, Gemini models, model APIs, embeddings, vector search, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agent-based patterns where appropriate.
* Use modern AI-assisted engineering tools effectively for design, coding, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting while applying secure-development and human-review controls.
* Implement prompt management, evaluation, guardrails, observability, responsible AI practices, and output validation for production AI features.
* Platform Reliability
* Drive platform availability, performance, security, accessibility, operational readiness, cost optimization, and production support across frontend, backend, cloud, and AI components.
* Develop automated unit, integration, API, UI, security, and performance tests and maintain CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code.

Experience: 8+ years of progressive software or platform engineering experience, including substantial hands-on delivery of enterprise full-stack applications and cloud-native platforms.
  
  
- Full-Stack Engineering:

* Expert-level Java and Spring Boot development, including microservices, REST APIs, security, testing, performance tuning, and production troubleshooting.
* Strong Angular and TypeScript expertise, including component architecture, state management, reusable UI patterns, responsive design, accessibility, and automated testing.

title: Software Dev Engineer II, Profit Intelligence
description:
**Description**
Are you interested in building intelligence systems from the ground up?
  
  
Are you interested in working with Applied Scientists, Big Data Engineers and Software Development Engineers to build large-scale data intelligence systems?
  
  
Are you interested to work in a team that positively impacts different key pillars of Amazon like Pricing, Promotions, Advertising, Auto inventory purchasing, Auto inventory removal, Inventory placement?
  
  
Are you interested in working for a team that builds cool systems yet has great work-life balance?
  
  
Profit intelligence systems measures, predicts true profit(/loss) for each item as a result of a specific shipment to an Amazon customer.
  
  
Prot Intelligence is all about providing intelligent ways for Amazon to understand profitability across retail business. What are the hidden factors driving the growth or profitability across millions of shipments each day?
  
  
Profit Intelligence provides these answers.
  
  
We compute the profitability of each and every shipment that gets shipped out of Amazon. Guess what, we predict the profitability of future possible shipments too. We are a team of agile, can-do engineers, who believe that not only are moon shots possible but that they can be done before lunch. All it takes is finding new ideas that challenge our preconceived notions of how things should be done. Process and procedure matter less than ideas and the practical work of getting stuff done. This is a place for exploring the new and taking risks.
  
  
We push the envelope in using cloud services in AWS as well as the latest in distributed systems, forecasting algorithms, and data mining.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to design and build AI-powered data platforms that transform large-scale business data into actionable insights. You will work at the intersection of machine learning, distributed systems, and data engineering — owning end-to-end development of tools that help business leaders make faster, better decisions.
  
  
This is a high-impact role on a team where the software you ship directly shapes financial and operational strategy across Amazon.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Architect and build scalable platforms that ingest, process, and serve insights from petabyte-scale datasets
  
  
Integrate large language models and generative AI capabilities into internal analytics tools — enabling natural language querying, anomaly explanation, and automated reporting
  
  
Design ML pipelines for anomaly detection, forecasting, and trend analysis over structured and semi-structured business data
  
  
Partner with scientists, analysts, and PMs to translate ambiguous business problems into well-scoped technical solutions
  
  
Drive engineering excellence: define coding standards, lead design reviews, and set the bar for operational health (monitoring, oncall, runbooks)
  
  
Mentor junior engineers; raise the technical capability of the team through clear documentation and code review
  
  
Own your services in production — you build it, you run it
  
  
Build and operate our foundational data infrastructure comprising of the entire spectrum of AWS Services - Storage (Redshift Data Shares, s3 data lakes), Orchestration (Step Functions, Glue and Internal Java Based Orchestration Tools), Processing (Spark & Flink - KDA), Streaming services (AWS Kinesis) and real-time large scale event aggregation stores.
  
  
Making it fully configurable and self-service for non-engineers.
  
  
Build and evolve tools that empower Amazonians to access data and build reliable, scalable and configurable way to generate Unit Economics for all Amazon Businesses. This includes UIs and frameworks for configuring rules, simulating their application, approval workows for rule changes, APIs and caching layers for high-throughput serving of Unit Economics Historicals and Predictions.
  
  
Build systems that secure and govern our data end to end: control access across multiple storage and access layers (like inhouse Reporting Applications and BI tools), track data quality, catalogue datasets and their lineage, detect duplication, audit usage and ensure correct data semantics.
  
  
You will be responsible for designing and building platforms for crunching 100s of TB of in-coming data from dozens of sources and financial events around the company.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Support Engineer III, Chronicle
description:
**Description**
Impact
  
  
Ever wondered how Amazon offers the Earth's biggest selection and still manages to offer lower prices every day to our customers? Our retail business teams work with a massive array of vendors and business financial performance metrics to expand selection and drive costs lower. Given the rapid growth of our business, this requires our category leaders, financial analysts, site merchandisers and vendor managers to quickly analyze vendors, categories and brands, diving deep into data showing business efficiency down to the unit sale level. The technology that enables this has huge visibility and impact and is critical to Amazon's continued profitability and growth.
  
  
Innovation
  
  
We're working on the future. If you are seeking an environment where you can drive innovation. If you want to apply state-of-the-art software technologies to solve real world problems. If you want the satisfaction of providing visible benefit to end-users in an iterative fast paced environment, this is your opportunity. The responsibilities of this role will be key in paving the future of Amazon Retail and transforming how we do business.
  
  
Opportunity
  
  
You will be part of a team of creative, top-notch engineers who work hard, have fun, and make history.
  
  
As a Support Engineer, you will build systems that secure and govern our data end to end: control access across multiple storage and access layers (like in-house Applications and external aplications ), track data quality, catalogue datasets and their lineage, detect duplication, audit usage and ensure correct data semantics.
  
  
You will be responsible for crunching and providing support for petabytes of in-coming data from dozens of sources and financial events around the company.
  
  
Be part of a high performance, high profile team with a complete, entirely localized business charter to enhance business profitability for the Amazon Consumer business.
  
  
Platform runs entirely on AWS; high scale, engineering challenges.
  
  
Very successful team that has developed a reputation of delivering results within Amazon.
  
  
We regularly research new technologies and invest for the future of our scalability
  
  
This role is on the Chronicle team within Selling Partner Services. We own the Turismo product suite, which is powered by Ripple, a dynamic query engine. Turismo is a well loved product, with 15k+ users globally. Ripple is a PrestoDB based query engine that is built to scale, and processes 2M+ queries per week. We are a full stack team, with Product managers, UX designers, TPMs, SDEs, DEs and Data Scientists.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Provide support of incoming tickets, including extensive troubleshooting tasks, with responsibilities covering multiple products, features and services
* Work on operations and maintenance driven coding projects
* Software deployment support in staging and production environments
* Develop tools to aid operations and maintenance
* System and Support status reporting
* Ownership of one or more ETL products or components
* Customer notification and workflow coordination and follow-up to maintain service level agreements

**Description**
Amazon.com is looking for a talented and enthusiastic Senior Software Development Engineer to join the Digital Content Platform team. The Digital Acceleration Commerce team owns services supporting the publishing, pricing and purchase of Digital content, including Kindle Books, Amazon AppStore, Amazon Music, Amazon Video, etc.
  
  
This candidate will be joining a team working on scalable web services using cloud technologies. The work will be highly visible to Amazon customers and internal stakeholders.
  
  
As a Senior Software Development Engineer, this person will lead the architecture and development of high-scale web services and workflows. A successful candidate will have an established background in designing and developing back-end web services, strong technical skills, a motivation to achieve results in a fast-paced environment, high creativity, and great analytical reasoning skills.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As a Software Development Engineer III (SDE3) on the Digital Pricing and Promotions team, you will design and build software solutions that power promotional capabilities across Amazon's Digital Acceleration (DA) businesses — including Kindle, Prime Video, and Music. You will own and evolve critical platforms that deliver promotional management, competitive pricing intelligence, and operational automation to pricing managers, business teams, and product managers across DA.
  
  
You will take meaningful ownership of key products — particularly the Promos UI platform — driving features from initial design through deployment and ongoing maintenance. Your work will span full-stack development: crafting user interfaces with modern web technologies, building robust backend services in Java on AWS, and integrating with Retail promotion systems such as PLM (Promotion Lifecycle Management).
  
  
In this role, you will make architectural decisions that balance near-term business needs with long-term scalability and maintainability. You will think across systems — considering performance at scale, multi-business extensibility, and integration with diverse data sources and downstream services. You will lead technical designs independently, engage actively in design reviews, and provide substantive code review feedback that raises the bar for the team.
  
  
Collaboration is central to this role. You will work closely with operations teams, business stakeholders, Retail promotion platform teams, and partner engineering organizations. You will develop a deep understanding of customer workflows and pain points, translating them into well-designed, reliable solutions. You will champion operational excellence through proactive monitoring, incident response, and identifying opportunities for automation and process improvement.
  
  
Beyond individual delivery, you will help grow the team — mentoring junior engineers, contributing to development best practices, and driving technical improvements that increase the team's overall velocity and reliability. Success in this role means consistently shipping high-quality features that advance our promotional capabilities while setting a strong example for engineering craft and customer focus.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 7+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 7+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Technical Anchor, Software Engineering
description:
As a Technical Anchor, you will oversee the technical design, development, and delivery of business-critical applications and high-throughput data platforms. You will establish engineering excellence across full-stack systems, architect resilient Java-based microservices, deliver responsive front-end data exploration interfaces using React or Angular, and design enterprise-grade cloud data streaming and analytical pipelines on GCP. You will lead distributed engineering squads across local and global locations, driving cloud modernization, data governance, and operational reliability to fuel Ford’s digital transformation.
  
  

* Technical Leadership, Architecture & Modernization
* Anchor Technical Delivery: Act as the primary technical anchor, translating complex business requirements from legacy applications in GDIA into scalable, fault-tolerant system designs, architectural blueprints, and execution roadmaps.
* Architecture Standards: Drive the evolution of Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA), cloud-native microservices, and event-driven patterns. Establish coding standards, API contracts (OpenAPI/Swagger), and architectural governance across squads.
* Legacy System Modernization: Lead legacy modernization initiatives by re-architecting monolithic services into modular, containerized workloads on GCP, engineering continuous ingestion flows from heterogeneous enterprise platforms.
* Engineering Mentorship & SDLC Excellence: Champion agile engineering best practices, enforce test-driven development (TDD), lead comprehensive code reviews, and mentor engineers across full-stack, data engineering, and cloud domains.
* Full-Stack & Microservices Engineering
* Backend Services: Architect and develop robust, high-performance microservices and RESTful APIs using Java 17+, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and supporting synchronous transactions and asynchronous event-driven flows.
* Frontend & Data Visualization: Build responsive, user-centric interfaces using Angular, React, and Node.js that integrate seamlessly with backend APIs to deliver intuitive self-service data access, reporting, and interactive data visualization.
* API Gateway & Service Mesh: Design and standardize API gateway topologies using Apigee; enforce service discovery, circuit breakers, rate limiting, and resilient inter-service communication.
* Performance Engineering & Optimization: Profile and optimize distributed systems end-to-end, including JVM tuning, connection pooling, caching strategies, and database query tuning across relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL datastores.
* Cloud Data Engineering & Analytics
* Scalable Data Pipelines: Architect, build, and maintain real-time streaming and high-volume batch data pipelines leveraging GCP Dataflow (Apache Beam), Dataproc (Spark/Hadoop), and Cloud Pub/Sub.
* Modern Data Warehousing: Standardize, model, partition, and optimize enterprise datasets within Google BigQuery to ensure exceptional SQL query performance, cost efficiency, and real-time analytical capabilities.
* Security, Governance & Compliance
* Zero Trust Security: Enforce least-privileged access control across applications, integrating Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), ADFS, OAuth2/OIDC, and method-level access authorization.
* Cloud & Data Governance: Implement robust cloud security frameworks, including Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), data encryption (in transit and at rest), data masking, and GCP-native row-level and column-level security.
* Regulatory Compliance: Partner with cybersecurity, compliance, and governance teams to maintain adherence to enterprise data privacy mandates and corporate security standards.
* DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure & Observability
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Automate and manage repeatable cloud infrastructure and platform provisioning using Terraform.
* CI/CD Automation: Design and optimize enterprise CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Tekton, and build automation tools (Maven, Gradle) for automated testing, static code analysis, and zero-downtime deployments.
* Operational Reliability & Telemetry: Establish proactive monitoring, tracing, and alerting frameworks across Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), Cloud Run, and Cloud Functions to diagnose distributed system bottlenecks and ensure platform health.
* AI/ML Innovation: Apply foundational AI and Machine Learning (ML) concepts, including Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs), to accelerate engineering workflows and enhance software capabilities.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience).
* Professional Experience: 10+ years of progressive software engineering experience delivering enterprise-scale solutions across full-stack development, distributed computing, and data platforms. Core Technical Competencies:
* Backend Engineering: Deep expertise in Java (Java 17+), Spring Ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Data, Spring Security), and scripting proficiency.
* Frontend Engineering: Hands-on experience developing data visualization and exploration interfaces using React, Angular, or Node.js.
* GCP Cloud Platforms: Proven track record architecting and deploying systems on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), specifically BigQuery, Cloud Run, GKE and Cloud Pub/Sub.
* Database Systems: Strong practical expertise with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL), NoSQL datastores, and columnar analytical warehouses.
* DevOps & IaC: Hands-on mastery of Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and automated CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, Tekton, Maven/Gradle).
* API & Testing Standards: Deep knowledge of RESTful API design (OpenAPI/Swagger) paired with a test-driven mindset using JUnit and Mockito

title: Full Stack Engineering Intern
description:
**About the job**

Complyance is a fast-growing e-invoicing and tax compliance SaaS company. Through a single API, we help businesses meet e-invoicing mandates across markets, including the UAE and Saudi Arabia’s ZATCA requirements, without rebuilding their finance systems every time a regulation changes. Our platform is live across 10+ jurisdictions, and we are now expanding from a strong MENA and India base into Europe and the US.

We build compliance and e-invoicing software across web applications, APIs, integrations, CRM systems, workflow automation and document-processing systems.

We are a growing startup with a small team, a broad engineering surface, and a strong focus on correctness, security and reliability. As an intern, you will contribute to real product development, not just observe, shadow or complete training exercises.

**Life at Complyance :**

You will receive guidance and feedback, but you should also be comfortable exploring problems independently and asking focused questions when you are blocked.

We hire for transferable fundamentals, ownership and learning ability, not familiarity with a specific language or framework.

**The mission :**

Your core focus is AI-assisted full-stack product development. You will work across frontend and backend systems, understand existing code, implement well-defined features, investigate defects and test your work carefully.

You will work directly on product areas including CRM workflows, project management systems, business process automations, integrations and internal productivity tools, building features that support real customer and internal business processes.

We use approved AI coding assistants and coding agents in our daily engineering workflow, and you will be expected to use them responsibly. But AI does not replace engineering judgement: you must understand and take responsibility for everything you submit.

**Where you’ll leave your mark :**

**•**
**Ship real features:**

 Build well-defined frontend and backend functionality across browser interfaces, APIs, application services, databases, integrations and asynchronous workflows.

**•**
**Build CRM and project management features:**

 Work on contacts, companies, leads, opportunities, pipelines and customer workflows, and on projects, tasks, assignments, statuses and priorities.

**•**
**Automate business processes:**

 Develop and maintain workflow automations using triggers, actions, conditions, scheduled jobs, notifications and webhooks that reduce manual work.

**•**
**Connect systems:**

 Build and maintain third-party integrations and APIs that link different systems and business workflows.

**•**
**Write code you can stand behind:**

 Read requirements and existing code first, write clear, maintainable code that follows our conventions, and create unit, integration and browser-level tests that cover failure scenarios, permissions and edge cases.

**•**
**Fix what’s broken:**

 Reproduce, investigate, fix and verify defects, and grow through code reviews.

**•**
**Communicate and keep learning:**

 Share progress, assumptions, risks and blockers early, document important technical decisions, and explain what you built, how it works, where it may fail and how you verified it.

**How we use AI :**

At Complyance, responsible AI usage is an expected engineering skill. You should be able to:

**•**

Give AI tools relevant context, constraints and a clear objective.

**•**

Use AI to explore code, compare approaches, scaffold bounded changes, generate tests and debug errors.

**•**

Review every AI-generated change before submitting it, and remove invented APIs, unsafe defaults, duplication, weak tests and unnecessary complexity.

**•**

Verify output through your own reasoning, automated checks and direct runtime testing.

**•**

Use only approved tools, and protect credentials, source code, customer information and regulated data.

**•**

Understand and explain everything you submit, however it was produced.

Generated code that you cannot explain or verify is not considered complete work.

**The kind of builder we’re looking for**

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

**•**

Have strong fundamentals in at least one programming language: control flow and functions, modules and code organisation, data structures, error handling, asynchronous behaviour and basic algorithmic trade-offs.

**•**

Understand HTML, CSS, browser behaviour and responsive interfaces.

**•**

Have completed at least one meaningful software project beyond a guided tutorial.

**•**

Have a basic understanding of HTTP, APIs, databases, data modelling, Git and pull requests.

**•**

Debug methodically and can explain the evidence behind a conclusion.

**•**

Have practical exposure to an AI coding assistant or coding agent while building software.

**•**

Are willing to test carefully, accept direct feedback and keep improving.

**•**

Investigate independently, ask clear and useful questions, and communicate well in writing and in conversation.

Your experience can come from internships, academic projects, freelance work, open-source contributions, hackathons or independently built products. Up to one year of relevant experience is a plus, but not mandatory.

**Bonus points :**

**•**

Basic familiarity with CRM concepts, such as contacts, companies, leads, opportunities and pipelines.

**•**

Basic familiarity with project management concepts, such as projects, tasks, assignments, statuses, priorities and dependencies.

**•**

Basic understanding of workflow automation, such as triggers, actions, conditions, scheduled jobs, notifications and webhooks.

**•**

Exposure to building or consuming third-party APIs and integrations.

**•**

Experience with automation platforms, workflow engines or business applications.

**What success looks like**

A successful intern at Complyance:

**•**

Delivers small, well-tested changes consistently.

**•**

Learns from feedback and avoids repeating the same mistakes.

**•**

Investigates before making assumptions, and raises blockers promptly rather than letting work stall.

**•**

Understands how technical changes affect users and business workflows.

**•**

Treats testing, documentation, security and production readiness as part of development.

**•**

Takes ownership of submitted work, including work created with AI assistance.

**•**

Becomes increasingly independent while maintaining a high standard of correctness.

**•**

Can take a requirement, understand the existing system, implement the change, test it and explain the result clearly.

**Why Complyance?**

**•**

Competitive base salary. The range will be shared with shortlisted candidates.

**•**

Comprehensive benefits, including health insurance for you and your family and paid time off.

**•**

The chance to build for a category that is being shaped by regulation right now, across some of the fastest-moving e-invoicing markets in the world.

**•**

A lean, collaborative team where your work is visible and your decisions matter.

**How to apply**

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Job Details

**•       Location: Kottivakkam, OMR, Chennai (onsite)**

**•       Working hours: 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM**

**•       Compensation: ₹3.5 – 4.0 LPA, based on skills and experience**

The Company

Launched in 2002, Venture Intelligence is an AI-powered fintech company that provides data, analysis and research on startups, venture capital and private equity transactions in India. We offer a range of subscription products, which is used by leading venture capital firms, private equity firms, investment banks, and other financial institutions to make informed investment decisions. Venture Intelligence data is also relied upon by the regulatory agencies, the media as well as the official Indian PE-VC industry association, IVCA.

The Role

We are looking for a Full Stack Developer who works the way modern engineers do: using AI coding tools (LLMs) extensively for coding, debugging, testing and problem-solving, while taking full ownership of code quality, correctness and security.

We are not looking for someone who just generates code fast. We want someone who can read, question, test and improve what the AI produces, and who can solve the problem from first principles when the AI gets it wrong.

What You Will Do

•       Build and improve features across our React front end and Laravel / Python back end.

•       Design clean REST APIs and build fast, usable interfaces for data-heavy screens (large tables, filters, search, pagination).

•       Write and optimise MySQL schemas, indexes and queries for large financial datasets.

•       Build background jobs, data-processing scripts and integrations in Python.

•       Use AI tools daily, and review every AI-generated change as carefully as you would a colleague's pull request.

•       Write tests, take part in code reviews, and help keep the codebase secure and maintainable.

Must-Have Skills

•       
**React.js:**
solid command of Hooks, component design and state management; TailwindCSS or a similar CSS framework; responsive layouts.

•       
**One strong backend:**
PHP (Laravel) or Python (Django / Pandas). You should be comfortable designing and consuming REST APIs.

•       
**MySQL:**
schema design, indexing and query optimisation (you can explain why a query is slow and how to fix it).

•       
**Fundamentals:**
HTTP, async behaviour, authentication, and common security issues (SQL injection, XSS, secrets handling).

•       
**Working knowledge of Git**
and code review practices.

Good to Have

•       Both Laravel and Python experience (we use both).

•       Redis or other caching layers.

•       Deploying and running apps on Linux servers or AWS.

•       Experience with data-heavy or analytics / fin-tech products.

•       Chennai-based, Tamil-speaking candidates are preferred.

Experience and Education

•       1-2 year experience building web applications with React and Laravel or Python.

•       Bachelor's / Master's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

How We Work With AI

We actively encourage AI-assisted development. Here is what good looks like for us:

•       You check AI output before trusting it: read the diff, run it, and write tests.

•       You can spot hallucinated APIs, insecure code and slow queries in generated code.

•       You can explain every line you commit, and why you chose that approach.

•       You keep learning new tools and share what works with the team.

Selection Process

•       
**Step 1, Online assessment:**
a practical exercise where you review and fix code that contains realistic bugs and weaknesses.

•       
**Step 2, Technical interview at our office**

title: Intern – Full Stack Developer
description:
**Intern – Full Stack Developer (React.js, Next.js & Headless CMS)**

We are looking for a motivated Full Stack Developer Intern with a strong interest in React.js, Next.js, and modern web development. The candidate should understand the fundamentals of frontend and backend development and have an interest in building scalable, responsive, and high-performance web applications.

Familiarity with headless CMS architecture and hands-on exposure to platforms such as Strapi or Storyblok will be an added advantage. The intern will collaborate with the development team to build web applications, integrate APIs, and support CMS-driven website development.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Frontend Development:**
  Build responsive, reusable, and user-friendly interfaces using React.js, Next.js, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
* **Next.js Development:**
  Work with routing, layouts, reusable components, rendering strategies, and other Next.js capabilities.
* **Headless CMS Integration:**
  Integrate headless CMS platforms such as Strapi or Storyblok with React.js and Next.js applications.
* **CMS Content Modeling:**
  Understand and work with content types, components, schemas, dynamic content, and structured content models.
* **API Integration:**
  Integrate REST APIs and other supported APIs to retrieve and display content and application data.
* **Website Development:**
  Support the development, enhancement, and maintenance of CMS-driven websites and web applications.
* **Backend Development:**
  Assist with server-side functionality, API development, business logic, and backend integrations using Node.js or suitable technologies.
* **Database Management:**
  Work with databases and support data retrieval, storage, and basic CRUD operations.
* **Performance Optimization:**
  Help improve website speed, responsiveness, accessibility, and search engine visibility.
* **SEO & Metadata:**
  Implement dynamic page metadata, titles, descriptions, and other SEO-related elements for CMS-driven pages.
* **Testing & Debugging:**
  Identify and resolve bugs, test functionality, and maintain code quality.
* **Version Control:**
  Use Git and GitHub for source control, collaboration, and code management.
* **Documentation & Collaboration:**
  Follow development standards, document implementations, and collaborate with developers, designers, and project stakeholders.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Basic to intermediate knowledge of React.js and component-based development.
* Familiarity with Next.js and its application structure.
* Knowledge of JavaScript (ES6+) and basic understanding of TypeScript.
* Understanding of HTML5, CSS3, responsive design, and modern frontend development.
* Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, and API integration.
* Basic understanding of Node.js and backend development concepts.
* Familiarity with Git and GitHub.
* Understanding of asynchronous programming, debugging, and browser developer tools.
* Basic understanding of databases and CRUD operations.
* Understanding of the headless CMS concept and the separation of content management from frontend presentation.

**Headless CMS Skills**

* Familiarity with
  **Strapi or Storyblok**
  is preferred.
* Understanding of content types, components, content modeling, and content delivery APIs.
* Ability to connect CMS content with React.js and Next.js applications.
* Basic understanding of dynamic page rendering and reusable, CMS-driven frontend components.
* Familiarity with content publishing workflows, preview functionality, and SEO metadata management through a CMS is an advantage.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience building academic, personal, or freelance web development projects.
* Hands-on experience with React.js and Next.js through projects or internships.
* Experience integrating Strapi or Storyblok with a frontend application.
* Familiarity with Tailwind CSS, Material UI, or similar styling frameworks.
* Exposure to PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or other databases.
* Understanding of authentication, authorization, and secure coding practices.
* Familiarity with deployment platforms, cloud hosting, and CI/CD fundamentals.
* A GitHub profile or portfolio demonstrating web development projects.

**What We Offer**

* Practical experience with modern web development technologies.
* Exposure to React.js, Next.js, and headless CMS-based website architecture.
* Opportunities to contribute to real-world website development and enhancement projects.
* Learning opportunities in API integration, backend development, performance optimization, and deployment.
* Experience working with collaborative development workflows and version control.

A career with U.S. Bancorp India gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.
  
  
**Job Description**
Job Description: Senior Software Engineering Manager – MMC (India)
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a
**Senior Software Engineering Manager**
to lead engineering delivery for the
**Money Movement Capability (MMC)**
application in India. This leader will play a critical role in building and scaling U.S. Bank's India engineering presence for MMC by managing a high-performing team of software developers and quality engineers, strengthening engineering practices, and partnering closely with U.S.-based leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
  
  
This is a managerial leadership role for a technically strong engineering leader who can operate with broad direction, focus on the bigger picture, and drive execution across multiple domains. The ideal candidate combines deep technical experience with people leadership, architectural judgment, delivery rigor, and a strong understanding of payments systems. This role requires business knowledge in the Payments domain, including Zelle, RTP, and FedNow, along with the ability to build software products that are scalable, reliable, maintainable, and aligned to business strategy.

* Team Leadership & India Organization Build-Out
* Lead, grow, and develop a team of engineers and QEs in India supporting the MMC application
* Help establish and scale the India engineering organization, including hiring, onboarding, coaching, and creating a strong engineering culture for U.S. Bank
* Drive career development, technical mentoring, performance management, and succession planning across the team
* Create an accountable, inclusive, and high-performing environment focused on quality, ownership, and continuous improvement
* Engineering Delivery & Execution
* Manage under broad direction and objectives, with a focus on business outcomes, delivery quality, and operational stability
* Drive execution of the product roadmap on time and within budget while ensuring security, compliance, and reliability of core systems
* Guide teams toward strong coding practices, solid software design decisions, and high-quality delivery with minimal disruption to production
* Set expectations across the organization and ensure dependencies, risks, and delivery constraints are identified and addressed early
* Promote urgency, prioritization, and thoughtful trade-off decisions aligned to organizational strategy
* Technical Leadership & Architecture
* Provide high-level architectural guidance and help teams align solution design to business requirements, enterprise standards, and regulatory needs
* Ensure technical designs are clear, well thought out, and account for dependencies, failure states, maintainability, testability, scalability, and ease of support
* Develop and maintain high-level and detailed architecture designs for complex technology solutions across multiple platforms, frameworks, and languages
* Lead architectural review sessions and technical design discussions across the organization
* Simplify product and technical design where possible to improve speed, resilience, and supportability
* Cross-Team Strategy & Stakeholder Partnership
* Partner with business leaders, product managers, architects, and engineering teams in an agile environment to gather requirements and drive execution
* Participate in roadmap discussions and provide feedback to product and business teams based on engineering strategy, technical constraints, and delivery considerations
* Understand adjacent teams' business domains and influence cross-team decisions to deliver business value efficiently
* Communicate technical decisions, architecture strategies, and delivery risks effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Quality, Operations & Incident Leadership
* Drive a culture of quality, timely code reviews, release readiness, and engineering discipline across the organization
* Coach teams on systematic debugging, problem diagnosis, and effective use of tools for troubleshooting
* Lead incident response as needed and establish processes and tooling that improve issue detection, root-cause analysis, and repeat-issue prevention
* Ensure teams proactively handle risk, change, and ambiguity, escalating concerns early with practical solution options

**Technical Scope**
The Senior Software Engineering Manager is expected to bring strong hands-on technical credibility and experience building modern distributed systems. This role will guide teams delivering software products and APIs in a payments ecosystem with high expectations for availability, performance, resiliency, and compliance.
  
  
Expected technical experience includes:
  
  

* Experience building highly maintainable, extensible, and testable distributed systems
* Experience in microservices and API development using Java and Spring Boot
* Experience designing low-latency, high-throughput applications built for scalability and reliability
* Experience implementing user interfaces against REST APIs
* Experience with Kafka, event-driven patterns, and open-source technologies used in modern application development
* Experience with containerization and platform tooling such as Kubernetes, Rancher, Istio, Apigee, Jenkins/CloudBees, and GitLab
* Familiarity with source control management best practices, DevOps principles, and agile software delivery lifecycle practices
* Experience troubleshooting complex technical issues and driving resolution in production environments

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree, or equivalent work experience
* 10 to 12 years of relevant technical experience
* 5 or more years of leading a software engineering team
* Proven experience leading software engineers and offshore teams to deliver complex products with multiple stakeholders
* Strong understanding of software development processes, architecture, and engineering tools in enterprise environments
* Comprehensive knowledge of how business strategy aligns with technical and engineering strategy
* Strong analytical, planning, leadership, and communication skills
* Ability to communicate effectively with engineers, product owners, scrum masters, business partners, vendors, and customers

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Business domain knowledge in Payments, especially ACH, Wires, Zelle, RTP, and FedNow
* Experience in Business Banking, Payment Services, Financial Services, or other regulated industries
* Advanced knowledge of distributed systems architecture, microservices architecture, API management, and integration platforms
* Experience overseeing integration of new systems and technologies into existing environments
* Experience balancing technical debt, feature delivery, and operational reliability at scale
* Certifications in Java, Spring, Microservices, Cloud, or Azure are a plus

**Leadership Profile**
The ideal candidate is a leader who:
  
  

* Thinks beyond a single team and considers impacts across multiple domains
* Has a complete understanding of the team's domain, key features, affected users, impacted flows, and business purpose
* Takes initiative to clarify ambiguity, identify risk early, and guide teams toward sound decisions
* Fosters a culture of strong design patterns, coding standards, quality engineering, and accountable delivery
* Brings a mix of technical acumen, strategic thinking, execution discipline, and talent-building capability
* Can represent the India team effectively while partnering across global stakeholders and enterprise functions
