And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Senior Engineer - Java**
You will lead the team to deliver the projects from the technical deliverable perspective for our customers across the globe; you are expected to provide technical expertise and mentor the staffs in the projects primarily based on Java/J2EE or any emerging technology; you will lead the client interactions, work on project proposals when there is a need and also take part in any technical decisions/discussions with the architects; help in solution architectures on Java technologies or any emerging technologies for the projects.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for Java Seniors with expertise in Java technologies to join the Advisory Digital-FS Java team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of a new service offering.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Need to work as a technical lead in the development projects using Java technologies
* Working closely with our clients to understand their business, functional, technical, and implementation requirements
* Planning and monitoring of the project deliverables from the team
* Provide key input in technology stack evaluation and assist the architect in terms of technology choices for the projects when needed
* Design and govern the reusable accelerators, apply design patterns and reusable technical components (e.g. error handling, logging etc.)
* Working with the relevant teams to ensure the timely delivery of the projects
* Preparing technical solution and architecture documents, artefacts, work products and presentations for the customer
* Contribute towards excellence in a highly collaborative, team-oriented environment
* Lead and mentor development teams
* Work closely with Project Managers, Senior Business Analysts, and development teams
* Take ownership of the solution delivery, and be responsible for translating functional requirements into a solution
* Task allocation and performance evaluation of team members
* Communicate with client teams and gather requirements, conduct regular team meetings and track project progress
* Interview candidates when needed and help in the recruitment process
* Provide an efficient working atmosphere to project teams and ensure objectives are met within stipulated time
* A background of working with development best practices.
* A willingness to be flexible in responding to issues as they occur and the ability to identify product/deployment improvements to mitigate future occurrences.
* Self-motivated, Strong communication and team building skills.
* Work iteratively in a team with continuous collaboration.

**People responsibilities:**

* Foster teamwork and lead by example
* Ability to travel in accordance with client and other job requirements
* Excellent written and oral communication skills;

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Primary:**

* Experience in Java 17/21 and above / J2EE, Spring boot, JPA, Spring Cloud, Microservices, REST APIs
* Experience in Spring, Hibernate, SQL Server/Oracle, No SQL like - Mongo DB etc.,;
* Experience with messaging technologies (e.g. Kafka, MQ), Event processing technologies
* Knowledge on object-oriented programming and design patterns
* Working experience of designing & developing solutions in cloud environments preferably Azure
* Web Security: OAuth, SSO/SAML, LDAP- basics could be useful
* Experience on design patterns
* Experience with Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment
* Experience in projects managed in accordance with AGILE (SCRUM) methodology
* Knowledge on writing Unit test cases and carrying out Unit testing using Junit
* Version control software exposure Git, SVN, Clear case, PVCS
* Should have understanding and experience of software development best practices/clean coding practices/clean coding practices
* Attention to detail and commitment to high quality/error free deliverables
* Lead the team to come up with High level solution design in response to RFPs and be an expert in sizing the project and estimating the effort
* Knowledge on the CMMI framework
* Expertise in distributed architectures, microservices, Web Services, SOAP, REST, MOM integration technologies and message mediation techniques using an Enterprise Service Bus
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills leveraging all available resources
* Ability to connect technology with measurable business value

**Secondary**

* UI experience using AngularJS/Angular, React, HTML5, JQuery, JSON, JavaScript, Servlet, JSTL, AJAX and CSS will be an added advantage
* Working experience in cloud environments preferably Azure
* Knowledge on the CMMI framework

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Bachelor's/Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems Management or a related field.
* 6 to 9 years of experience
* Experience in leading the teams
* Knowledge on process methodologies – Agile/frameworks like CMMI

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Technical delivery skills

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 500 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Advisory and other service lines globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Python Lead / Lead Python Engineer
description:
**Python Lead / Lead Python Engineer**

Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: 10+ years

Joining Preference: Immediate joiners or candidates with a very short notice period

**About the Role**

We are looking for a highly experienced, hands-on Python Lead / Lead Python Engineer to drive technical feasibility, application architecture, backend development, AI-enabled solutions, and end-to-end product delivery.

This is a player-coach role combining hands-on Python engineering with technical leadership. You will evaluate new product ideas, build proof of concepts (PoCs), make architecture decisions, lead a team of engineers, and take applications from feasibility to production.

The ideal candidate should also have strong practical knowledge of
**AI/GenAI technologies, including LLM integrations, RAG architectures, vector databases, and AI Agent development**
, and be capable of evaluating and implementing AI-driven product capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct technical feasibility studies, PoCs, and build-versus-buy evaluations.
* Prepare feasibility reports with effort estimates, costs, risks, and go/no-go recommendations.
* Design scalable, secure, and maintainable Python applications, REST APIs, and AI-enabled backend systems.
* Develop backend services using Python and frameworks such as FastAPI, Django, or Flask.
* Design and implement
  **GenAI/LLM-powered applications, RAG pipelines,**
  and AI Agents.
* Evaluate and i
  **ntegrate LLMs and AI services such as OpenAI, Anthropic**
  , or equivalent platforms.
* Design AI application architecture including prompt orchestration, embeddings, vector search, retrieval pipelines, tool/function calling, and agent workflows.
* Own application architecture, code quality, performance optimization, and production releases.
* Work with PostgreSQL / MySQL, Redis / MongoDB, task queues, message brokers, and vector databases.
* Manage cloud deployments, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and production operations.
* Lead, mentor, and guide a team of 3–6 engineers.
* Drive code reviews, sprint planning, technical documentation, and engineering best practices.
* Collaborate with the Founder / CTO and stakeholders to ensure timely product delivery.
* Stay current with emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities to leverage AI/automation to improve product capabilities and engineering efficiency.

**Requirements**

**Mandatory Skills**

* 10+ years of overall software engineering experience.
* 6+ years of hands-on production experience with Python 3.x.
* Strong experience with FastAPI, Django, or Flask and REST API development.
* Experience designing and delivering at least two production systems end to end.
* Proven experience in technical feasibility studies and PoCs.
* Strong practical knowledge of
  **AI/GenAI and LLM-based application development.**
* Hands-on experience with
  **RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architectures**
  and implementation.
* Hands-on experience building AI Agents / Agentic AI workflows, including tool/function calling, orchestration, and multi-step task execution.
* Experience integrating LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or equivalent providers.
* Strong understanding of embeddings, vector search, semantic search, chunking, retrieval strategies, and vector databases.
* Ability to design and implement production-ready AI applications with appropriate considerations for accuracy, latency, scalability, security, cost, and observability.
* Strong database knowledge:
  **PostgreSQL or MySQL, plus Redis**
  or MongoDB.
* Experience with Celery / RQ or equivalent task queues and RabbitMQ / Kafka / SQS.
* Production experience with
  **AWS / Azure / GCP, Docker, and CI/CD.**
* Hands-on experience with pytest, code quality tools, and Python type checking.
* Knowledge of application security,
  **OAuth2 / JWT, OWASP Top**
  10, and access control.
* At least 2 years of experience leading 3+ engineers.
* Strong communication, problem-solving, estimation, and delivery ownership skills.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Applied cryptography, key management, and secure licensing mechanisms.
* Kubernetes, Terraform, Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry.
* React / Next.js familiarity.
* Performance optimization using
  **Rust, Cython**
  , or Go.
* Experience taking products from concept to production and first customers.
* Experience with advanced agentic AI patterns such as multi-agent systems, MCP, workflow orchestration, AI tool integration, and autonomous task execution.
* Experience with AI evaluation, observability, guardrails, prompt/version management, and LLM cost optimization.

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for a strong hands-on technical leader who can move seamlessly between Python engineering, system architecture, AI/GenAI implementation, technical feasibility, and team leadership.

The right candidate should be comfortable taking an idea from concept → feasibility → PoC → architecture → development → AI integration → production deployment, while making sound technical and business-oriented decisions along the way.

**Position Summary**

title: Associate Architect
description:
**Job Description: Associate Architect**

**Role Title:**
Associate Architect

**Department:**
Intelligent Automation

**Location:**
Chennai, India

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Experience Level:**
Mid-to-Senior Level (7 to 12 years)

**About the Role**

We are seeking a high-performing
**Software Engineer transitioning into Architecture (Aspirant Architect)**
. In this pivotal role, you will bridge the gap between hands-on code execution and high-level architectural design.

You will work directly alongside Principal Architects, Technical Leads, and Engineering Managers to architect, evaluate, and scale distributed systems on modern cloud platforms. This role is built for a senior-level developer with strong software engineering fundamentals, deep cloud and distributed systems experience, and a passion for system design, data modeling, and technical leadership.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Architectural Design & Technical Leadership**

* Assist in drafting architectural blueprints, tech stack evaluation documents, and Architecture Decision
* Perform trade-off analyses balancing performance, maintainability, security, scalability, and operational costs across cloud services and codebases.
* Help define and enforce coding standards, API specifications (REST/gRPC/GraphQL), and design patterns across delivery teams.

**2. Hands-on Engineering & Prototyping**

* Write production-ready, highly maintainable code (primarily using
  **Python**
  or equivalent modern languages).
* Build Proofs-of-Concept (PoCs) to test emerging technologies, validate architectural hypotheses, and bench-test performance bottlenecks.
* Troubleshoot complex, non-deterministic bugs and failure modes in distributed production environments.

**3. Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps Integration**

* Architect resilient, highly available cloud applications on
  **AWS**
  or
  **Azure**
  using microservices, serverless, and containerized topologies.
* Collaborate with DevOps engineers to establish Infrastructure as Code (IaC), continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, and deployment strategies (Canary, Blue/Green).
* Integrate full-stack observability (logging, metrics, distributed tracing) into software architecture from inception.

**4. Data Modeling & System Design**

* Design efficient relational (SQL) and non-relational (NoSQL) schemas optimized for read/write access patterns, storage efficiency, and data integrity.
* Implement event-driven and streaming architectures using message brokers (e.g., Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS/SNS, Azure Event Grid).

**5. SDLC Execution & Engineering Mentorship**

* Champion the end-to-end Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)—from threat modeling and capacity planning to post-launch monitoring.
* Conduct high-impact code and design reviews, mentoring mid-level and junior engineers on clean architecture, principles, and system resilience.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

**Technical Competencies**

* **Software Development:**
  7+ years of hands-on software engineering experience using
  **Python**
  or similar languages (Go, Java, C#).
* **Distributed Computing:**
  Proven experience designing and operating distributed systems. Strong understanding algorithms, caching strategies (Redis/Memcached), load balancing, and fault-tolerance patterns (Circuit Breakers, Bulkheads).
* **Cloud Platforms:**
  3+ years of building and deploying production workloads on
  **AWS**
  (e.g., EKS/ECS, Lambda, DynamoDB, RDS, S3) or
  **Azure**
  (e.g., AKS, Azure Functions, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL).
* **Data Modeling:**
  Proficiency in designing data schemas) and database migrations, and query optimization.
* **DevOps & IaC:**
  Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), IaC tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, or Bicep), and automated pipeline tools (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps).
* **Full SDLC Mastery:**
  Practical exposure to complete software life cycles, agile methodologies, secure coding practices (OWASP top 10), and automated testing frameworks (Unit, Integration, E2E).

**Behavioral & Aspirant Attributes**

* **Architecture Mindset:**
  Strong grasp of software design philosophies (Domain-Driven Design, SOLID principles, 12-Factor App methodology, Clean Architecture).
* **Communication:**
  Ability to explain complex technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders and write concise technical documentation.
* **Continuous Learner:**
  Eagerness to evolve from feature implementation to enterprise-wide system strategy.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have**

* AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate/Professional) or Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
* Experience with data engineering pipelines (Airflow, Spark, or similar).

title: Software Engineering Manager - Java Full Stack - Open Banking
description:
At U.S. Bancorp India, we’re on a journey to do our best. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bancorp India gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Global Engineering Leadership & India Expansion
* Lead and scale a high-performing global engineering organization, including building and expanding the India team supporting Acquisition and Open Banking platforms.
* Establish a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, quality, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Drive talent strategy across hiring, onboarding, mentoring, performance management, and succession planning.
* Foster an inclusive, accountable environment that promotes collaboration, technical excellence, and leadership growth.
* Platform Engineering & Architecture (Acquisition & Underwriting)
* Own the design and evolution of API-first, event-driven platforms enabling digital acquisition and real-time underwriting.
* Architect decoupled systems separating customer journeys, decisioning, and core banking platforms to improve scalability and agility.
* Establish reusable platform capabilities (decisioning, identity, fraud, KYC, and data integration) consumable across products, channels, and partners.
* Drive engineering excellence in distributed systems, scalability, and secure Open Banking integrations.
* Execution, Delivery & Operational Performance
* Lead delivery of the product and platform roadmap with clear accountability for business outcomes, quality, and operational stability.
* Ensure predictable, on-time, and within-budget execution while meeting security, compliance, and reliability standards.
* Promote strong engineering practices, including high-quality code, sound design decisions, and production stability.
* Proactively manage dependencies, risks, and trade-offs, ensuring alignment with organizational priorities and strategic goals.
* Technical Leadership & Architectural Governance
* Provide strategic architectural direction, aligning solutions to business needs, enterprise standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure designs are scalable, resilient, maintainable, and testable, with clear handling of dependencies and failure scenarios.
* Lead architecture reviews and design forums, driving consistency and simplification across platforms.
* Continuously simplify systems to improve speed, reliability, and supportability.
* Cross-Functional Strategy & Stakeholder Engagement
* Partner with product, business, risk, and architecture leaders to define and deliver acquisition and underwriting capabilities.
* Influence roadmap decisions by balancing engineering strategy, customer experience, risk, and delivery constraints.
* Drive alignment across teams to enable efficient, end-to-end value delivery across the ecosystem.
* Communicate architecture, strategy, and delivery risks clearly to both technical and executive stakeholders.
* Resiliency, Risk & Operational Excellence
* Define and enforce resiliency standards (tiering, SLOs, failover strategies) for mission-critical acquisition and underwriting flows.
* Ensure high availability and low-latency performance for real-time decisioning systems.
* Lead incident management, root cause analysis, and continuous reliability improvements across the platform.

**Technical Scope**
The Senior Software Engineering Manager is expected to bring strong
**hands-on technical leadership and credibility**
in designing and delivering
**modern, distributed, and scalable platforms**
. This role leads engineering teams building
**API-first acquisition and Open Banking solutions**
, with a focus on
**real-time decisioning, resiliency, performance, and regulatory compliance**
.
  
  
**Core Technical Expectations**

* Design and build highly scalable, resilient, and maintainable distributed systems, with a strong emphasis on modularity, extensibility, and testability.
* Lead development of microservices, APIs, SDKs, and front-end components (MFE) using Java, Spring Boot, and modern UI frameworks aligned to API-driven architectures.
* Architect low-latency, high-throughput platforms to support real-time acquisition flows and credit decisioning workloads.
* Enable seamless integration across channels and partners through well-defined RESTful APIs and event-driven communication patterns.
* Apply event-driven architecture principles using Kafka and related streaming technologies to support asynchronous processing and real-time data flows.
* Leverage cloud-native and container-based platforms, including Kubernetes, Istio, Rancher, and API gateways (Apigee), to enable scalability, observability, and secure service communication
* Establish modern DevOps and CI/CD practices using tools such as Jenkins/CloudBees and GitLab, ensuring automated testing, deployment, and release management.
* Enforce best practices in source control, code quality, and agile delivery, driving consistency, speed, and reliability across engineering teams.
* Lead troubleshooting and resolution of complex production issues, ensuring rapid recovery, root cause analysis, and continuous system improvement.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10+ years of experience designing and delivering modern, distributed software systems.
* 5+ years of experience leading high-performing engineering teams, including globally distributed/offshore teams.
* Proven expertise building and scaling platform-based solutions with measurable business impact.
* Demonstrated ability to lead teams in delivering complex, multi-stakeholder products in fast-paced, enterprise environments.
* Strong understanding of software engineering practices, architecture patterns, and enterprise development tools.
* Ability to translate business strategy into technology and engineering outcomes, driving alignment across product, risk, and engineering.
* Strong analytical, planning, leadership, and communication skills, with the ability to influence across technical and non-technical audiences.
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively with engineers, product managers, scrum teams, business stakeholders, and external partners.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong domain expertise in customer acquisition, credit underwriting, and Open Banking ecosystems.
* Experience in financial services or other highly regulated industries, with an understanding of risk, compliance, and security requirements.
* Advanced knowledge of distributed systems, microservices architecture, API platforms, and event-driven integration patterns.
* Experience leading modernization initiatives, including integrating new platforms with legacy systems in enterprise environments.
* Demonstrated ability to balance feature delivery, technical debt, and operational reliability at scale.
* Experience with cloud-native platforms and engineering ecosystems (Azure, containers, CI/CD, API management).
* Relevant certifications in Java, Spring, Microservices, or Cloud technologies are a plus.

**Leadership Profile**
The ideal candidate is a leader who:
  
  

* Thinks and operates at a platform and ecosystem level, considering impacts across domains, customer journeys, and partner integrations.
* Demonstrates deep understanding of end-to-end acquisition and underwriting flows, including users, systems, and business outcomes.
* Proactively addresses ambiguity, risks, and dependencies, guiding teams toward sound, data-driven decisions.
* Builds a culture of strong engineering fundamentals, including design patterns, coding standards, quality engineering, and accountability.
* Combines technical depth, strategic thinking, and disciplined execution to deliver consistent results.
* Effectively represents and scales global engineering teams, especially across India and U.S.-based stakeholders.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
description:
Drip · Full-time · On-site

Location: Chennai, India (on-site, not remote)

Required: At least 8 hours a day of overlap with US Eastern business hours

About Drip

Drip (dripshop.live) is an AI-native, gamified commerce platform for Pokémon, One Piece, Magic: The Gathering, and sports cards. Collectors open Instant Packs backed by real graded cards in our vault, compete in Pack Battles, and buy and sell through livestreams, auctions, and a marketplace.

We're a small, profitable team that has grown double digits month over month on average, and our team is fully AI-native. We're looking for a senior engineer in Chennai who can turn a product idea into a reliable feature across React and Node.js, from the first prototype through launch and iteration.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role with meaningful input into the product and responsibility for how your work performs in production.

What you'll own

You'll work closely with product and design to shape and ship features end to end.

Take Pack Battles, where two players open Instant Packs head to head and the best pull wins both cards. On a feature like this, you would:

- Design the data model and APIs, then build the frontend, real-time updates, and payment flow.

- Create a usable prototype independently and collaborate with our designer to refine the experience.

- Test critical flows and failure cases, deploy safely, and monitor production behavior.

- Instrument the feature, track its performance, and improve it using data and user feedback.

What you bring

- Production experience: 6+ years building production software, including 4+ years of hands-on experience with React and Node.js/TypeScript.

- Systems judgment: You design clear data models and APIs, understand race conditions, idempotency, and consistency, and can explain the tradeoffs behind your decisions.

- Effective AI-assisted development: You use Claude Code, Cursor, or similar tools daily for development and review. You understand their limitations and can explain, debug, and validate the code you ship.

- Product sense: You can turn a loosely defined problem into a usable feature, identify missing requirements, and make thoughtful decisions about scope and UX.

- Ownership of quality: You review code critically, write meaningful unit and integration tests, and use monitoring and failure handling to keep features reliable.

- Clear communication: You raise questions and tradeoffs early and work effectively with engineering, product, design, and business teammates across India and the US.

- Location and hours: You work on-site in Chennai and can overlap at least 8 hours a day with US Eastern business hours.

Collectibles knowledge (strongly preferred)

You collect or trade TCG or sports cards and understand grading, sealed products versus singles, and how cards are priced.

Helpful experience

Experience with payments, marketplaces, real-time systems, background jobs, or search is valuable. Web3 experience with Solana or EVM, native iOS/Android development, or AWS infrastructure is a bonus.

Our stack

Our core web platform uses TypeScript, React, Node.js, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, and AWS, with Stripe and PayPal for payments and Agora for live video. Beyond the core React/Node/TypeScript requirements, familiarity with the rest of the stack is helpful.

To apply

Send:

1. Your résumé and a GitHub profile, project link, or description of something you shipped.

2. A short example of a feature you owned from idea to production: what you built, how you used AI, and how you verified its output, including an error you caught.

Key responsibilities include gathering requirements, designing and testing solutions, creating documentation, and providing training and support to clients and end-users. Technical skills in SAP BTP and SAP UI5 are often required, along with experience in areas like cloud integration, production process, and shop floor automation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Solution Design & Blueprinting: Conduct requirements gathering sessions and lead blueprinting activities to align SAP DMC solutions with client business processes.
* Configuration & Implementation: Configure, implement, and support SAP DMC solutions, including shop floor execution, POD/UI customization, and integration with various systems.
* Integration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate SAP DMC with other SAP modules and third-party systems using tools like SAP Cloud Connector.
* Testing & Deployment: Coordinate end-to-end system testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), and support deployment and go-live activities.
* Training & Documentation: Create and deliver client training materials and sessions, as well as maintaining functional and technical documentation.
* Client & System Support: Analyze and troubleshoot issues in SAP DMC, ensuring smooth operation and providing ongoing support to clients.
* Pre-Sales Activities: Engage in demonstrations and solution presentations as part of pre-sales activities.

**Key Skills & Qualifications:**

* Experience: Proven experience in implementing and supporting SAP Digital Manufacturing/BTP solutions, often including at least one full SAP DM implementation.
* Technical Skills:
* Knowledge of Shop Order, SFC, and production execution concepts.
* Familiarity with SAP UI5, SAP BAS, cloud integrations, and API management.
* Understanding of shop floor automation, integration with production connectors, and scanner integration.
* Familiarity with manufacturing concepts such as Lot & Serial Manufacturing and Assembling & Confirmation.
* Knowledge of inventory processes like Goods Issue/Receipt (GI/GR).
* Methodology & Project Management: Experience with Agile methodologies and coordination of project implementation.
* Soft Skills: Strong client-facing skills, excellent oral and written communication, and the ability to build trust-based client relationships.

description:

**Position:**
Full-Stack AI Engineer

**About the Role**

At INNOVERIC, we help companies design, build, and scale intelligent software solutions using cutting-edge AI technologies.

We're currently hiring an
Full-Stack
AI Engineer to work on an exciting project focused on building a next-generation AI-powered communication app, bringing intelligent agents, communication channels, and automated workflows together into a unified platform.

We're looking for a passionate engineer with strong expertise in Agentic AI, multi-agent orchestration, and AI-native software development who enjoys building reliable, scalable, production-ready applications.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Design, develop, and deploy**
  AI agents and multi-agent systems.
* **Build intelligent workflows**
  using LangGraph, Google ADK, CrewAI, Vercel AI SDK, or similar frameworks.
* **Develop agent harnesses**
  , memory management, tool calling, and multi-agent orchestration.
* **Integrate external services**
  and communication platforms using MCP, A2A, REST APIs, and third-party integrations.
* **Build scalable backend services**
  and full-stack applications using Python and TypeScript.
* **Implement agent evaluations**
  , automated testing, monitoring, and observability.
* **Leverage AI coding agents**
  to accelerate software development while maintaining engineering quality.
* **Collaborate**
  with cross-functional teams to deliver production-ready AI solutions.

**Required Skills & Experience**

**AI & Agent Engineering**

* Hands-on experience with LangGraph, Google ADK, CrewAI, Vercel AI SDK, or similar frameworks.
* Strong understanding of LLM applications, agent orchestration, tool calling, and memory management.
* Familiarity with MCP, A2A, REST APIs, and third-party integrations.

**Software Engineering**

* Strong programming skills in Python and TypeScript.
* Experience with FastAPI, Next.js, React, or similar frameworks.
* Experience with Supabase (PostgreSQL) or other relational databases such as MySQL or SQL Server.
* Knowledge of OAuth 2.0 and authentication systems.

**Cloud & DevOps**

* Experience with cloud platforms such as Scaleway, AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Proficiency with Git, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with unit testing, integration testing, monitoring, and observability.

**AI-Native Development**

* Hands-on experience using Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Pi, or similar AI coding agents.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted software development, agent harness engineering, and modern engineering workflows.

**What We're Looking For**

* Strong software engineering fundamentals and problem-solving abilities.
* A builder's mindset with a passion for agentic AI.
* Ability to independently design and deliver end-to-end applications.
* Experience translating business requirements into reliable software.
* Curiosity about emerging AI technologies and modern software engineering practices.

**Why Join Us?**

At INNOVERIC, we work on real-world AI applications, from Voice AI and Agentic AI to multi-agent systems, model fine-tuning, and AI-native software engineering.

But beyond technology, we value people more than technology. We believe great companies are built through trust, genuine human connections, and growing together.

* **Real-world impact:**
  Build AI solutions that solve actual business problems.
* **People first:**
  We value your ideas, individuality, and contributions beyond your technical skills.
* **Grow together:**
  As we grow, you grow with us. Your personal and professional growth matters.
* **No ego, no politics, no games:**
  We believe in transparency, mutual respect, and honest collaboration.
* **Ownership and opportunity:**
  Take initiative, experiment, make decisions, and grow with the company.

No ego. No manipulation. Just meaningful business, genuine human connections, and shared growth. That's the culture we're building at INNOVERIC.

**How to Apply**

We want to see what you've built, not just read about it! If you've developed full-stack AI applications, AI agents, or multi-agent systems, we'd love to see your work.

**1. Your CV (Required)**

Include your relevant engineering experience and technical projects.

**2. Video Demo of Your Work (Required)**

Record a short walkthrough of an AI application or agentic system you've personally developed. Your video should explain:

* **What you built:**
  The problem you're solving and a working demonstration of your application.
* **How it works:**
  Key features, workflows, and AI capabilities.
* **System Architecture:**
  Overall architecture, tech stack, and how the components interact.
* **AI System Design:**
  Agent orchestration, memory, tool calling, data flow, and LLM integration, where applicable.
* **Engineering Decisions:**
  Architectural choices, trade-offs, and technical challenges you solved.

*Upload your video to Loom, YouTube (unlisted), Google Drive, or a similar platform and share an accessible link. Please avoid sharing confidential information or proprietary client code.*

**3. GitHub Repository (Optional)**

Share your GitHub repository or relevant technical documentation, if available.

**How to Submit**

* **Step 1:**
  Click
  **Easy Apply**
  on this LinkedIn job posting and submit your CV.
* **Step 2:**
  Email your video demo link to
  **careers@innoveric.com**
* **Email Subject:**
  AI Engineer Application | [Your Full Name]
* *You may also include your GitHub repository or project documentation in the same email.*

**Important:**
Both your LinkedIn application and video demo are required for your application to be considered complete.

* *A CV tells us about your experience. Your work shows us how you think, design, and build AI systems.*

title: Technical Lead
description:
Technical Lead – Apps Engineering TeamChennai, India
  
  
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior .NET Developer/Technical Lead with 10+ years of experience in designing, developing, and delivering scalable enterprise applications using C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET Core, SQL Server, and Microsoft Azure. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in microservices architecture, RESTful APIs, Entity Framework Core, Docker, Kubernetes, Azure cloud services, CI/CD, and Agile development practices. This role requires excellent problem-solving abilities, technical leadership, and the capability to manage multiple products while delivering high-quality, secure, and maintainable software solutions. Experience with cloud-native applications, event-driven architecture, and modern authentication frameworks such as OAuth2.0, JWT, Azure AD, or Keycloak will be an added advantage.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, development, and deployment of high-performance, scalable, and maintainable applications.
* Collaborate with product owners and stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Efficiently manage context switching between multiple products, ensuring focus and productivity across diverse tasks and projects.
* Architect, design, and implement microservices-based solutions using C#, .NET Core & .NET
* Develop data access solutions using Entity Framework Core.
* Apply design patterns (Factory, Singleton, Repository, etc.) to solve software design problems effectively.
* Optimize database performance and ensure efficient data access using SQL Server.
* Leverage Azure services, including AKS, App Service, and Azure Functions, to build cloud-native applications.
* Manage containerized applications using Docker and orchestrate with Kubernetes.
* Implement and maintain event-driven architectures using Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid, or similar tools.
* Design, develop, and maintain RESTful APIs for secure and scalable communication between services, integrating with Swagger/OpenAPI for documentation and OAuth2.0/OpenID connect for security.
* Conduct code reviews and provide technical mentorship to junior developers.
* Ensure adherence to Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban) and provide regular status updates on progress.

**Key Competencies & Skills**

* Proficiency in C# and .NET Core: Minimum 10 years of experience.
* Strong experience with SQL Server for database design, development, and optimization.
* Expertise in Entity Framework and Entity Framework Core for ORM and data access.
* Hands-on experience with Azure services (AKS, App Service, Azure Functions, Azure DevOps).
* Proficiency in designing and developing microservices architecture, with experience in Docker and Kubernetes for containerization and orchestration.
* In-depth knowledge of design patterns for scalable and maintainable code architecture.
* Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms with practical application experience.
* Experience in RESTful API design, with knowledge of Swagger/OpenAPI, OAuth2.0, and JWT for API security.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing frameworks (e.g., xUnit, NUnit), and version control systems (Git, GitFlow).
* Strong context switching ability, with the capacity to manage multiple products and shift focus between tasks efficiently.

**Additional Skills:**

* Familiarity with nHibernate and OData for advanced data access techniques.
* Experience with Test-Driven Development (TDD) methodologies.
* Understanding of Zeebe (workflow engine) and SignalR (real-time web functionality).
* Proficiency in PowerShell for scripting and automation tasks.
* Familiarity with identity management systems such as Keycloak and Azure AD for authentication and authorization.

**Education & Experience Requirements**

* Sound experience of designing and developing applications both individually and as part of a team
* Knowledge of a commodity or financial trading environment useful but not a pre-requisite
* Strong inter-personal and communication skills (both verbal and written)
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to develop innovative solutions to technical problems
* Experience of working in an Agile/Scrum team environment
* Educated to Degree-level (or equivalent), as a minimum requirement

**Who We Are**
Glencore is one of the world’s largest global diversified natural resource companies and a major producer and marketer of more than 60 commodities. Through a network of assets, customers and suppliers that spans the globe, we produce, process, recycle, source, market and distribute the commodities that advance everyday life.
  
  
With over 140,000 employees and contractors and a strong footprint in over 30 countries in both established and emerging regions for natural resources, our marketing and industrial activities are supported by a global network of offices.
  
  
Glencore’s customers are principally industrial consumers, such as those in the automotive, steel, power generation, battery manufacturing and oil sectors. We also provide financing, logistics and other services to producers and consumers of commodities.

title: Internship Program 2026 - Build Your Career Through Real Project Experience
description:
**Job Description**
Launch Your Career with Gway Tech Solutions Private Limited
  
  
**Gway Tech Solutions Private Limited**
is inviting applications from
**2026 graduates**
and a limited number of
**2025 graduates**
for our
**2027 project expansion plans**
.
  
  
We are looking for passionate, self-motivated individuals who aspire to build a successful career by gaining practical industry experience through real-time software development and business projects.
  
  
**Internship Opportunities Are Available In The Following Departments**

* MERN Stack Development
* Software Testing (Manual & Automation)
* Executive Assistant
* Product Design (UI/UX)
* Human Resources (HR)
* DevOps
* IT Support

This internship is designed for candidates who believe that
**knowledge, practical exposure, discipline, and continuous improvement are the foundation of a successful career.**
Unlike conventional training programs, this is a
**real-time industry learning opportunity**
where interns gain hands-on experience by working alongside experienced professionals on live projects.
  
  
Who Should Apply?
  
  
**This Internship Is Ideal For Candidates Who**

* Have graduated in 2026 or are selected from the 2025 graduate batch.
* Are interested in building a career in the ERP and business software domain.
* Are passionate about learning and building a long-term professional career.
* Are willing to learn through practical implementation rather than classroom training.
* Want genuine industry exposure through real-time projects.
* Are self-motivated and committed to continuous learning and improvement.
* Are willing to accept feedback and continuously improve their performance.
* Are prepared to demonstrate their knowledge and skills through practical work and assessments.
* Value knowledge, discipline, professional growth, and long-term career development.

**This program is not intended for candidates whose primary expectation is immediate stipend or salary.**
Our primary objective is to develop skilled professionals who are capable of building successful long-term careers through continuous learning, practical industry experience, discipline, and proven performance.
  
  
Who Should Not Apply?
  
  
Please carefully understand the nature of this opportunity before applying.
  
  
**Candidates Should Not Apply If They**

* Are not interested in the ERP domain or business software industry.
* Expect an immediate stipend or salary from the beginning of the internship.
* Are primarily looking for a paid internship rather than a performance-based learning opportunity.
* Are looking for an internship only to obtain a certificate.
* Are not willing to undergo strong assessments at every stage.
* Are not comfortable with performance-based continuation.
* Are looking only to complete the internship duration without focusing on learning and performance.
* Are not willing to continuously improve their knowledge and practical skills.
* Are not interested in proving their capabilities through actual work and performance.
* Are not interested in a potential long-term employment opportunity with the organization.
* Are unwilling to take ownership, accept feedback, maintain discipline, and demonstrate professional commitment.

Important
  
  
**This opportunity is not designed for candidates who are looking only for a certificate, immediate payment, or a short-term internship experience.**
**Certification is not guaranteed merely for joining or attending the program.**
This opportunity is for candidates who are genuinely willing to:
  
  
**Learn → Practice → Perform → Improve → Prove Themselves → Build a Career**
If you are genuinely interested in the ERP domain, willing to invest your time and effort in learning, and want to prove yourself through performance with the possibility of securing a
**Fresher employment opportunity**
, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
Nature of the Internship
  
  
This internship follows a
**Self-Learning with Industry Mentorship Model.**
**Candidates Will Be Expected To**

* Learn independently with guidance from mentors.
* Complete assigned learning modules and project tasks.
* Work on real client and internal projects.
* Take ownership of assigned responsibilities.
* Continuously improve technical and professional skills.
* Demonstrate discipline, professionalism, and accountability throughout the program.
* Accept feedback positively and implement improvements.
* Demonstrate consistent performance throughout the internship.

Success in this internship depends largely on the candidate's willingness to learn, adapt, take responsibility, and consistently perform.
  
  
Selection Process
  
  
Stage 1 – Five-Day Assessment Program
  
  
Before being admitted into the internship program, every applicant must successfully complete a
**5-working-day assessment**
.
  
  
During this assessment, candidates will be assigned practical tasks to evaluate not only technical aptitude but also professional qualities.
  
  
**The Evaluation Includes**

* Learning ability
* Problem-solving approach
* Discipline and punctuality
* Sincerity and commitment
* Professional ethics
* Ownership and accountability
* Communication skills
* Adaptability
* Consistency in task completion
* Overall suitability for the internship program

Only candidates who successfully complete this assessment will be offered internship positions.
  
  
Internship Structure and Stipend Eligibility
  
  
The internship will be for
**150 working days**
, divided into
**six blocks of 25 working days each**
.
  
  
Block Duration Stipend Blocks 1–3 75 working days
**No stipend**
Block 4 25 working days ₹5,000\* Block 5 25 working days ₹5,000\* Block 6 25 working days ₹5,000\*
**Total**
**150 working days**
**Up to ₹15,000**
\*
  
  
Stipend eligibility is directly connected to the candidate's performance and successful progression through the internship blocks.
  
  
**Candidates Who Successfully Progress To**
**Block 4 → ₹5,000 stipend**
**Block 5 → ₹5,000 stipend**
**Block 6 → ₹5,000 stipend**
will be eligible for the applicable stipend only after satisfying the required performance standards for the respective block.
  
  
The organization reserves the right to determine stipend eligibility based on the candidate's performance assessment.
  
  
Block-Wise Performance Assessment
  
  
At the end of
**every 25-working-day block**
, candidates will undergo a
**strict performance assessment**
.
  
  
**Each Assessment Will Evaluate**

* Technical learning progress
* Practical implementation skills
* Quality of work
* Discipline and attendance
* Professional behaviour
* Ownership of responsibilities
* Ability to improve based on feedback
* Team collaboration
* Communication
* Problem-solving ability
* Commitment towards career development
* Overall performance

**Candidates who successfully clear the assessment will be allowed to continue to the next block.**
Candidates who do not meet the required standards may be discontinued from the internship and will not be allowed to progress to the next block.
  
  
Performance-Based Continuation
  
  
Continuation in the internship is
**entirely based on performance**
.
  
  
**Candidates Who Consistently Demonstrate**

* Learning capability
* Professional conduct
* Improvement mindset
* Discipline
* Accountability
* Positive attitude
* Technical and practical improvement
* Consistency
* Commitment to excellence

will continue through the internship program.
  
  
Candidates who fail to meet the expected standards at any stage may be discontinued from the internship without progressing to the next block.
  
  
**Completion of a particular number of days does not automatically qualify a candidate for the next block. Successful assessment is mandatory for progression.**
Employment Opportunity
  
  
Candidates who successfully complete
**all six internship blocks (150 working days)**
with
**strong, consistent, and proven performance**
will be considered for a
**Fresher employment opportunity**
with the organization.
  
  
**Candidates Who Demonstrate**

* Strong learning capability
* Consistent performance
* Better assessment ratings
* Technical and practical competency
* Professional discipline
* Ownership and accountability
* Positive attitude
* Adaptability
* Ability to contribute effectively to the organization

may offered a
**Fresher role with a starting CTC of ₹1.8 LPA**
, subject to the organization's final assessment, available positions, and business requirements.
  
  
The employment opportunity is intended for candidates who successfully demonstrate strong performance and achieve the required assessment standards throughout the complete internship program.
  
  
Terms & Conditions
  
  
By applying for this internship, candidates acknowledge and agree to the following:
  
  

* Successful completion of the 5-working-day assessment is mandatory before joining the internship.
* The internship consists of six assessment blocks of 25 working days each, totaling 150 working days.
* The first three blocks, totaling 75 working days, are unpaid and no stipend will be provided during this period.
* Candidates must successfully clear the assessment of each block to continue to the subsequent block.
* Candidates who successfully progress to Blocks 4, 5, and 6 may be eligible for a stipend of ₹5,000 per block, subject to satisfactory performance and successful completion of the respective block.
* The maximum stipend payable during the final three blocks is ₹15,000.
* Stipend eligibility is performance-based and is not guaranteed merely by attendance or completion of the block.
* Candidates who fail to meet the required performance standards may be discontinued from the internship and will not be permitted to proceed to the next block.
* Candidates are expected to possess strong self-learning capability, discipline, professionalism, accountability, and a positive attitude towards continuous improvement.
* Candidates should remain fully focused on learning, performing, and building their careers throughout the internship.
* Any form of indiscipline, groupism, misconduct, unethical behaviour, misuse of company resources, or activities that negatively impact the learning environment will not be tolerated and may result in immediate discontinuation from the internship.
* Candidates are expected to maintain complete confidentiality regarding company information, projects, clients, intellectual property, and internal processes.
* Performance evaluations conducted by the organization shall be final and binding.
* Completion of the internship does not automatically guarantee employment.
* Candidates who successfully complete all six blocks with strong and consistently demonstrated performance may be considered for a Fresher position with a starting CTC of ₹1.8 LPA, subject to business requirements and available openings.
* Candidates who voluntarily discontinue the internship or whose internship is terminated due to unsatisfactory performance, misconduct, or violation of company policies will not be eligible to receive an Internship Completion Certificate or Experience Certificate for the period served.
* Candidates seeking only a certificate, immediate stipend, or immediate salary should not apply for this program.
* Certification is not guaranteed merely based on joining or attending the internship.
* All decisions made by the organization regarding assessment results, continuation, discontinuation, stipend eligibility, certification, and employment shall be final.

Ready to Build Your Career?
  
  
**If You Are**

* Self-motivated
* Disciplined
* Passionate about learning
* Interested in the ERP domain
* Willing to work hard
* Willing to learn through practical experience
* Ready to undergo strict performance assessments
* Looking for genuine industry exposure
* Committed to building a long-term career
* Interested in proving yourself through performance

we encourage you to apply and begin your professional journey with
**Gway Tech Solutions Private Limited**
.
  
  
**Learn. Perform. Improve. Prove Yourself. Build Your Career.**
**Apply Now and Shape Your Future with Us.**
Important Information
  
  
Limited Vacancies
  
  
**Please Note:**
Internship positions are limited. Applications will be processed on a
**first-come, first-preference basis**
, subject to eligibility and successful completion of the selection process.
  
  
We encourage interested candidates to apply as early as possible.
  
  
Assessment & Internship Details
  
  
**Location:**
Office-Based
**(On-Premises only)**

Chromepet, Chennai
  
  
**Working Days:**
Monday to Friday

9:30 AM – 7:30 PM
  
  
**Attendance:**
Continuous participation throughout both the Assessment and Internship is mandatory.
  
  
This internship is a full-time, office-based learning program. Candidates should ensure they can commit to the complete schedule before applying.
  
  
How to Apply
  
  
If You Are Genuinely Interested In This Opportunity, Please Submit Your Application Along With Your Updated Resume And Provide Detailed Responses To The Following Questions
  
  
1️⃣ Why do you believe you are a suitable candidate for this internship?

3️⃣ Availability Confirmation

Important Notice

Application Process

The ideal candidate brings deep technical expertise in Workday integrations, reporting, and platform development, combined with strong stakeholder engagement skills and a commitment to governance, standardization, and continuous improvement. This role will partner closely with business, HR, Finance, and IT teams to design, build, support, and optimize Workday solutions while contributing to the ongoing evolution of the Workday platform.

**Workday Integrations Development**

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and support Workday integrations using:
* Workday Studio
* Core Connectors
* Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB)
* Reports-as-a-Service (RaaS)
* Workday Web Services (SOAP/REST APIs)
* Develop and maintain inbound and outbound integrations across Workday, Payroll, Finance, Benefits, Identity Management, and third-party applications.
* Configure and manage Integration System Users (ISUs), integration security, authentication methods, and middleware connectivity.
* Monitor integration performance, troubleshoot production issues, and implement scalable solutions aligned with enterprise standards.
* Drive integration lifecycle activities including requirements gathering, design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing support.

**Workday Reporting & Analytics**

* Design and develop Advanced, Matrix, BIRT, and operational reporting solutions to support business and operational requirements.
* Build dashboards, scheduled report deliveries, and self-service reporting capabilities for HR, Finance, Payroll, and leadership stakeholders.
* Develop and maintain calculated fields and reporting frameworks that support enterprise reporting standards.
* Optimize report performance, usability, and data quality while ensuring governance and consistency.

**HCM & Financials Platform Support**

* Partner with business stakeholders supporting HCM and Financials business processes.
* Contribute to initiatives supporting Procure-to-Pay, Invoice-to-Cash, and Record-to-Report business functions.
* Collaborate with Finance teams to expand and support Workday Financials capabilities, including Financial Data Model (FDM) structures and reporting requirements.
* Assist with financial process automation, reporting enhancements, and integrations supporting procurement and financial operations.

**Platform Governance & Best Practices**

* Promote platform governance through documentation, standardization, naming conventions, reference ID management, and reusable design patterns.
* Maintain technical documentation for integrations, reports, data mappings, and support processes.
* Apply enterprise best practices for security, data governance, audit readiness, and operational support.
* Support ownership and accountability models through dedicated ISUs and integration governance frameworks.

**Workday Release & Continuous Improvement**

* Participate in Workday bi-annual release activities, including:
* Release note reviews
* Preview tenant testing
* Regression testing
* Evaluation of automatically enabled and opt-in features
* Assess impacts to integrations, reports, and business processes and coordinate implementation plans.
* Identify opportunities to improve platform efficiency, automation, and user experience.

**Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Partner with HR, Finance, Payroll, Employee Experience, IT, and business stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver technical solutions.
* Participate in cross-functional project teams supporting new implementations, enhancements, and transformation initiatives.
* Collaborate effectively with global teams across APAC, EMEA, and North America.
* Support flexible collaboration models to accommodate global stakeholder engagement.

**Mentorship & Knowledge Sharing**

* Mentor junior developers, analysts, and operational teams on Workday integrations, reporting, calculated fields, and platform best practices.
* Support knowledge transfer initiatives and promote self-service reporting capabilities within business functions.
* Contribute to team capability development through training, documentation, and peer coaching.

**Innovation & Productivity**

* Leverage modern productivity and AI-enabled tools to improve planning, analysis, testing, documentation, and operational efficiency.
* Participate in continuous learning and evaluation of emerging Workday technologies, testing tools, and platform capabilities.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of Workday experience with strong emphasis on technical development.
* Proven hands-on expertise with:
* Workday Studio
* Core Connectors
* EIBs
* RaaS
* Workday Web Services (SOAP/REST)
* Middleware integrations
* ISU management
* Strong experience developing and supporting Workday reporting solutions, including:
* Advanced Reports
* Matrix Reports
* BIRT Reports
* Dashboards and scheduled reporting
* Experience supporting full project lifecycles including requirements gathering, design, development, testing, deployment, and support.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills across HR, Finance, Payroll, and IT organizations.
* Experience working within Agile delivery environments and Jira-based project management processes.
* Demonstrated commitment to documentation, governance, and operational excellence.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to Workday Financials, including Financial Data Model (FDM) concepts and financial reporting requirements.
* Experience supporting Procure-to-Pay, Invoice-to-Cash, or Record-to-Report business processes.
* Familiarity with Workday Security concepts including role-based and user-based security groups.
* Exposure to Prism Analytics, Composite Reports, Kainos, Testmo, or other testing and automation platforms.
* Workday certifications in Integrations, Reporting, HCM, or Financials.
* Experience leveraging AI-enabled productivity tools such as ChatGPT Enterprise, Claude, NotebookLM, or similar technologies.

**Success Profile**
The successful candidate will be a technically strong Workday professional who can quickly contribute across integrations and reporting while partnering effectively with global stakeholders. They will demonstrate strong ownership, collaboration, documentation discipline, and a continuous learning mindset while helping advance the organization's Workday HCM and Financials platform capabilities.

* Master Data Management
* Approval Workflows
* User and Role Management
* Notifications
* API Integrations
* Document Management

The candidate should learn to translate a business requirement into a technical implementation.
  
  
**Business Requirement → Workflow → API → Database → User Interface → Validation → Testing**
A willingness to understand why a feature is required, rather than simply implementing instructions, is essential.
  
  

* Full Stack Development

The candidate will work on both backend and frontend development.
  
  
Backend Development
  
  
**Learn, Develop, And Maintain Backend Services Using:**

* NestJS
* Node.js
* TypeScript
* REST API development
* Mongoose ODM
* MongoDB
* API integration
* Request validation
* Error handling
* Authentication and authorization
* Business logic implementation
* Backend debugging and optimization

**Responsibilities Include:**

* Developing backend functionality.
* Implementing APIs based on requirements.
* Integrating APIs with frontend applications.
* Debugging backend errors.
* Following existing architectural patterns.
* Writing clean, reusable, and maintainable code.

Frontend Development
  
  
**Develop And Maintain User Interfaces Using:**

* React.js
* JavaScript
* TypeScript
* Redux
* Redux-Saga
* Formik
* React Hook Form (RHF)
* Reusable React components
* State management
* REST API integration
* Form validation
* Responsive UI development

**Responsibilities Include:**

* Developing reusable frontend components.
* Implementing forms and business workflows.
* Integrating APIs.
* Managing application state.
* Debugging UI issues.
* Implementing appropriate validation and error handling.
* Following existing UI/UX designs.
* Ensuring functionality works correctly across supported browsers.
* MongoDB & Database Development

The candidate will gain practical experience working with MongoDB in enterprise applications.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Understanding MongoDB collections and documents.
* Working with Mongoose schemas.
* Developing database queries.
* Implementing CRUD operations.
* Understanding relationships between ERP entities.
* Learning MongoDB aggregation pipelines.
* Debugging database-related issues.
* Following data validation standards.
* Understanding data integrity and consistency.
* Learning basic database performance optimization.

The candidate must handle database changes carefully, particularly when working with existing ERP data.
  
  

* AI-Assisted Development

**Active use of AI tools for software development is an important expectation of this role.**
The candidate should learn to use AI-assisted development tools to improve development speed, accuracy, and problem-solving ability.
  
  
**AI Tools Should Be Used To Support:**

* Understanding unfamiliar code.
* Generating code suggestions.
* Debugging errors.
* Explaining technical concepts.
* Refactoring code.
* Developing API functionality.
* Creating test cases.
* Understanding database queries.
* Preparing technical documentation.
* Investigating implementation approaches.
* Identifying potential edge cases.
* Improving repetitive development activities.

The candidate must understand that AI-generated code should never be accepted blindly.
  
  
All AI-assisted code must be reviewed, understood, validated, and tested before being used in the application.
  
  
**The Candidate Should Continuously Learn To Answer:**

* Can this requirement be implemented more efficiently?
* Can AI help identify the root cause of this bug?
* Can repetitive development work be automated?
* Can the solution be made more accurate and maintainable?
* Have the generated changes been properly tested?

**The expectation is not simply to use AI, but to use it intelligently to produce better software in less time.**

* Rapid Development & Productivity

The candidate should develop the ability to complete assigned development tasks efficiently without compromising quality.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Understanding requirements before coding.
* Breaking tasks into manageable steps.
* Reusing existing components and services.
* Following established coding patterns.
* Avoiding unnecessary code duplication.
* Identifying and resolving development blockers.
* Minimizing avoidable rework.
* Completing assigned tasks within agreed timelines.
* Using AI tools appropriately to accelerate development.
* Continuously improving technical skills and productivity.

The objective is to deliver
**more useful, reliable functionality in less time**
, rather than simply writing more code.
  
  

* Ownership & Accountability

We expect candidates to demonstrate responsibility for the tasks assigned to them.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Understanding assigned requirements clearly.
* Taking responsibility for task completion.
* Providing progress updates.
* Communicating blockers promptly.
* Meeting agreed delivery timelines.
* Testing completed functionality.
* Fixing issues identified during testing.
* Following tasks through to completion.
* Asking relevant questions when requirements are unclear.
* Learning from mistakes and avoiding repeated errors.
* Documenting important implementation details where required.

Candidates should develop the habit of taking ownership of their work rather than waiting for continuous instructions.
  
  
**If you encounter a problem, investigate it, understand it, attempt a solution, and communicate clearly when assistance is required.**

* Code Quality & Development Standards

The candidate must learn and follow established software development standards.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Writing clean and readable code.
* Following naming conventions.
* Developing reusable components and services.
* Avoiding unnecessary duplication.
* Implementing proper error handling.
* Following validation standards.
* Understanding separation of concerns.
* Following existing application architecture.
* Participating in code reviews.
* Addressing review feedback.
* Maintaining basic technical documentation.
* Avoiding unnecessary changes to unrelated functionality.

The objective is to develop software that can be maintained and enhanced by other developers.
  
  

* Git, GitHub & Version Control

Practical knowledge of Git and GitHub is expected.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Using Git for version control.
* Creating and managing branches.
* Committing code with meaningful messages.
* Pushing changes to GitHub.
* Understanding pull requests.
* Resolving basic merge conflicts.
* Following the organization's branching strategy.
* Keeping changes organized.
* Participating in code reviews.
* Learning how version control supports collaborative development.

Candidates must understand the importance of protecting the existing codebase and avoiding unapproved changes to production code.
  
  

* Jenkins, CI/CD & Deployment Support

The candidate will gain exposure to automated build and deployment processes.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Understanding Jenkins pipelines.
* Learning continuous integration and continuous deployment.
* Supporting application build processes.
* Investigating build failures.
* Understanding application deployment workflows.
* Supporting deployment-related troubleshooting.
* Following release procedures.
* Learning how code moves from development to testing and production.
* Coordinating with the DevOps team when environment-related issues arise.

The candidate should gradually develop a practical understanding of the complete software delivery lifecycle.
  
  

* Debugging & Problem Solving

Strong analytical and problem-solving ability is essential.
  
  
**The Candidate Should Learn To Investigate:**

* Frontend errors.
* Backend errors.
* API failures.
* Database issues.
* Integration problems.
* Validation errors.
* Unexpected application behaviour.
* Performance issues.
* Business workflow inconsistencies.
* Browser-specific issues.

**The Expected Troubleshooting Approach Is:**
**Understand the Problem → Reproduce It → Investigate the Cause → Implement a Solution → Test the Fix → Prevent Recurrence**
Candidates should demonstrate the ability to investigate problems systematically rather than relying only on trial and error.
  
  

* Testing & Application Reliability

The candidate will be responsible for validating assigned development work before considering it complete.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Testing new functionality.
* Validating API responses.
* Testing input validation.
* Checking error handling.
* Verifying database operations.
* Testing relevant business workflows.
* Identifying edge cases.
* Fixing defects.
* Supporting QA activities.
* Retesting resolved issues.
* Ensuring existing functionality has not been unintentionally affected.

The candidate should understand that a feature is not complete merely because the code has been written.
  
  
**A task is complete when the functionality works as expected and the implementation has been appropriately validated.**

* Current & Future Product Development

The candidate will contribute to the continued development of GwayERP and other enterprise applications.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Understanding the existing application architecture.
* Learning the purpose of different ERP modules.
* Developing new functionality.
* Supporting enhancements to existing modules.
* Fixing reported defects.
* Implementing API integrations.
* Improving existing code where required.
* Learning application performance optimization.
* Following established architectural patterns.
* Adapting to new technical requirements.
* Contributing to future product development.
* Technical Learning & Continuous Improvement

We are looking for candidates who are serious about building a career in software development.
  
  
**The Candidate Is Expected To:**

* Learn unfamiliar technologies when required.
* Research technical problems independently.
* Read official documentation.
* Understand the code before modifying it.
* Practise effective debugging.
* Learn from code reviews.
* Improve programming fundamentals.
* Develop a deeper understanding of ERP workflows.
* Explore AI-assisted development methods.
* Improve development speed without sacrificing quality.
* Document useful findings and solutions.
* Stay updated with relevant development practices.

**Your ability to learn, apply knowledge, and improve continuously is more important than knowing every technology at the time of joining.**

* Required Technical Skills

Backend
  
  

* Basic knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript.
* Fundamental understanding of Node.js.
* Basic understanding of NestJS or willingness to learn it.
* Understanding of REST APIs.
* Basic knowledge of backend application development.

Frontend
  
  

* Basic knowledge of React.js.
* Understanding of HTML and CSS.
* JavaScript fundamentals.
* Basic understanding of component-based development.
* Familiarity with frontend API integration.

Database
  
  

* Basic understanding of MongoDB.
* Familiarity with CRUD operations.
* Willingness to learn Mongoose ODM.
* Understanding of data structures and validation.

Development Tools
  
  

* Git and GitHub fundamentals.
* Familiarity with VS Code or a similar development environment.
* Willingness to learn Jenkins and CI/CD.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools.

Good to Have
  
  

* TypeScript.
* NestJS.
* Redux and Redux-Saga.
* Formik.
* React Hook Form.
* MongoDB aggregation.
* Docker fundamentals.
* Basic API testing.
* Familiarity with ERP or business applications.
* Eligibility & Experience
* Fresh graduates in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related discipline may apply.
* Candidates with 0–1 year of relevant experience are welcome.
* Academic projects, internships, personal projects, and practical coding experience will be considered.
* Candidates should have a genuine interest in full-stack development.
* A strong understanding of programming fundamentals is expected.
* Practical knowledge demonstrated through projects is an advantage.

**We value demonstrated ability, learning potential, problem-solving skills, and commitment over the number of technologies listed on a resume.**

* Professional Qualities

**The Ideal Candidate Should Demonstrate:**

* Strong willingness to learn.
* Logical and analytical thinking.
* Problem-solving ability.
* Attention to detail.
* Ownership of assigned work.
* Accountability.
* Good communication.
* Time management.
* Adaptability.
* Curiosity about technology.
* Willingness to accept feedback.
* Ability to work collaboratively.
* Commitment to continuous improvement.
* Responsible use of AI tools.
* Interest in understanding business processes.
* Performance Expectations

The candidate's progress and performance will be evaluated based on:
  
  

* Understanding of assigned requirements.
* Quality of code.
* Development speed and consistency.
* Accuracy of implementation.
* Ability to debug issues.
* Completion of assigned tasks within agreed timelines.
* Effective use of AI-assisted development.
* Reduction in avoidable rework.
* Adherence to coding standards.
* Quality of testing.
* Understanding of ERP workflows.
* Collaboration with the development team.
* Willingness to learn and apply new technologies.
* Improvement in individual productivity over time.

The expectation is to progressively become a dependable developer who can handle increasingly complex ERP development tasks.
  
  

* Growth Opportunity

This role provides an opportunity to gain practical experience in building enterprise ERP applications.
  
  
**The Candidate Will Develop Skills Across:**
**Programming Fundamentals → Full Stack Development → ERP Workflows → API Development → Database Design → AI-Assisted Development → Testing → Deployment → Production Application Development**
As technical capability improves, the candidate will have the opportunity to work on more complex modules, integrations, application enhancements, and development responsibilities.
  
  

* The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a fresher who is enthusiastic about software development and interested in solving real business problems through technology.
  
  
You do not need to know everything before joining.
  
  
**However, You Should Be Willing To:**

* Learn new technologies.
* Understand business requirements.
* Write and test code.
* Investigate errors.
* Use AI tools intelligently.
* Take responsibility for assigned tasks.
* Meet agreed timelines.
* Improve your technical skills continuously.
* Understand how ERP applications support businesses.
* Deliver reliable and maintainable software.

We are particularly interested in candidates who can combine
**rapid learning, disciplined development, AI-assisted productivity, and a strong sense of responsibility**
.
  
  
Our Expectation
  
  
We do not expect you to be an expert on your first day.
  
  
We expect you to become better every day.
  
  
If you are ready to learn, build, experiment, solve problems, and contribute to real-world ERP products, we would like to hear from you.
