title: Devsecops
description:
**Job Summary**
Synechron is seeking an experienced Java Full Stack Developer to craft scalable, secure, and high-performance enterprise applications. This role involves designing and developing robust back-end services with Java frameworks like Spring and Hibernate, alongside creating engaging front-end interfaces using modern technologies. The candidate will collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement solutions that support business growth, operational efficiency, and enterprise resilience, ensuring the delivery of high-quality, maintainable systems.
  
  
**Software Requirements**
*Required Software Proficiency:*

* Java (latest LTS version, e.g., Java 17 or 11) — strong experience supporting scalable, enterprise-grade applications
* Spring Framework: Spring Boot, Spring MVC — extensive knowledge for microservices and backend architecture support
* Hibernate — experience in ORM data access supporting complex transaction management
* Front-end technologies: JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3 — for building responsive, user-friendly web interfaces supporting enterprise standards
* Version control: Git, GitHub — managing source code, supporting collaboration, and code integrity

*Preferred Software Skills:*

* Build automation: Maven, Gradle support for streamlined build processes
* Front-end frameworks: Angular 20, React.js, or Vue.js support for UI enhancements (preferred)
* Cloud platforms: AWS, Azure, or GCP supporting cloud-native deployment and scalability (preferred)
* API management & integration: REST, GraphQL, supporting distributed system communication and data sharing

**Overall Responsibilities**

* Lead the development of scalable, reliable, and secure enterprise applications based on Java and modern front-end frameworks
* Collaborate across teams to convert business requirements into technical solutions, supporting microservices and API-driven architectures
* Design, develop, test, and optimize back-end services supporting high transaction volumes and operational workflows
* Create and maintain user interfaces supporting usability, responsiveness, and security standards
* Conduct code reviews, enforce best practices, and mentor junior developers for code quality and technical excellence
* Support continuous integration, deployment, and infrastructure automation supporting agile delivery cycles
* Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement performance and security improvements
* Maintain comprehensive documentation supporting architecture, API specifications, and operational procedures

**Technical Skills (By Category)**

* Languages & Frameworks (Essential):

+ Java (latest LTS), Spring Boot, Spring MVC — core for microservices and enterprise back-end systems
+ JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3 — for frontend development supporting enterprise UI/UX standards

* Databases & Data Management:

+ SQL: Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL — supporting data persistence, retrieval, and transaction management
+ ORM frameworks: Hibernate — for data access and complex query support

* Cloud & Infrastructure:

+ AWS, Azure, GCP support for deployment and scaling of applications (preferred)
+ Cloud-native tools supporting containerization and deployment (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) (preferred)

* Tools & Methodologies:

+ Git, Maven, Gradle supporting version control and build automation
+ Agile/Scrum project management practices supporting iterative development and continuous integration

* Security & Compliance:

+ Knowledge of secure coding, API security (OAuth2, JWT), and enterprise security standards supporting compliance (preferred)

**Experience Requirements**

* 5-8 years of experience developing and supporting full-stack enterprise applications using Java-based frameworks
* Proven expertise in building scalable, high-availability microservices and RESTful APIs supporting business operations
* Hands-on experience with front-end frameworks supporting enterprise UI development (Angular 20, React.js, or Vue.js preferred)
* Familiarity with cloud deployment, containerization, and CI/CD processes supporting enterprise operational standards
* Prior experience working in regulated industries (finance, healthcare, or enterprise) supporting compliance and security standards (preferred)

**Day-to-Day Activities**

* Develop, enhance, and maintain scalable full-stack applications supporting enterprise workflows
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define requirements, develop APIs, and implement front-end and back-end features
* Conduct code reviews, performance tuning, and security assessments supporting high-quality deliverables
* Support automation of deployment pipelines, container orchestration, and infrastructure provisioning
* Troubleshoot production, system, and security incidents to ensure high system availability and security
* Maintain detailed documentation supporting architecture, deployment procedures, security controls, and operational workflows
* Support system upgrades, cloud migrations, and infrastructure support activities in line with operational SLAs

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field
* 5-8 years supporting full-stack enterprise applications built using Java frameworks and modern front-end technologies
* Certifications supporting Java, cloud platforms, or security best practices are advantageous (preferred)
* Proven experience designing scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions supporting enterprise growth and regulatory compliance

**Professional Competencies**

* Strong analytical skills to troubleshoot complex system issues and optimize performance in full-stack environments
* Leadership qualities to guide and mentor team members and promote best practices in software development
* Effective stakeholder communication supporting requirement translation, reporting, and documentation
* Adaptability supporting evolving technology stacks, security standards, and enterprise needs
* Strategic thinking supporting scalable, secure, and compliant platform development supporting business objectives
* Organizational skills to manage multiple projects and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment

***S***

description:
**Role Overview:**

As a Senior Software Engineer - Full Stack, you will design, develop and deliver of secure, scalable and high-performing enterprise applications across the user interface, application and data layers. A hands-on senior engineer who independently designs and delivers complex React + Java/Spring Boot functionality, owns modules from design through production, contributes to technical decisions, solves complex engineering problems and mentors junior engineers. • Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a related field.

**Required Experience**

• 4-7 years of software engineering experience delivering enterprise applications across front-end and backend technologies.

• Experience owning complex modules, contributing to technical design discussions and mentoring junior engineers.

• Proven experience designing, developing and supporting cloud-native full-stack applications in production.

• Experience working with distributed global teams or within a Global Capability Center is an advantage.

**Essential Skills**

• Strong expertise in Java 17+, Spring and Spring Boot for distributed microservices.

• Advanced proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3 and responsive web design.

• Hands-on expertise in React.js and component-driven architecture; working knowledge of Angular or Vue.js is valuable.

• Experience with state management, reusable UI components, accessibility (WCAG) and cross-browser compatibility.

• Deep understanding of microservices architecture, domain-driven design, event-driven design and cloud-native deployments.

• Experience building and consuming REST APIs and working with Kafka/RabbitMQ, asynchronous patterns and distributed transactions.

• Proficiency with relational and NoSQL databases, Hibernate/JPA, caching frameworks and data-access optimization.

• Strong foundation in Git, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, unit/integration testing, observability and production support.

• Experience with OAuth2, JWT, API security and secure coding practices.

• Ability to contribute to technical designs, conduct rigorous code reviews and mentor junior engineers in full-stack delivery.

**Desired Skills**

• Experience with React Native, micro frontends or server-side rendering.

• Exposure to service mesh, API gateways, distributed tracing and resilience frameworks.

• Experience with infrastructure-as-code and multi-cloud environments.

• Familiarity with Agile/SAFe, SRE principles and engineering process optimization.

• Knowledge of front-end and backend observability, performance profiling and automated quality tooling.

• Design and develop end-to-end of enterprise full-stack applications across multiple workstreams.

• Design and develop Java 17+ and Spring Boot microservices, REST APIs and event-driven integrations.

• Contribute to architecture and design reviews, conduct code reviews, and ensure deliverables meet quality and security standards.

• Drive performance optimization across browser, API, application and database layers.

• Ensure production readiness through structured logging, distributed tracing, health checks, metrics and resilience patterns.

• Troubleshoot, root-cause analysis and resolution of complex issues across environments.

**Support and Enablement**

• Mentor junior engineers and promote clean code, test automation, secure coding and consistent engineering standards.

• Maintain technical documentation, API specifications, reusable component libraries, runbooks and service catalogs.

• Collaborate with DevOps teams to strengthen CI/CD pipelines, automated quality gates and deployment workflows.

• Partner with UX, product, architecture and backend/frontend teams to ensure cohesive user and system experiences.

• Evaluate emerging technologies and contribute to platform modernization, technical roadmaps and architecture decisions.

Build and delivery

* Configure and build complex applications.
* Design and implement integrations between us and external enterprise systems.
* Own the hardest technical parts of an implementation, and unblock delivery teams when they hit the limits of the platform or the data model.

Customer and stakeholder engagement

Partner enablement and quality

* Define reusable patterns, templates, and technical standards that the wider delivery ecosystem can adopt.

**Qualifications**

* Experience. 3 to 6 years in enterprise software implementation, solution consulting, or technical delivery, including meaningful time on low-code / no-code, BPM, or workflow automation platforms.

**Required Skills**

* Data modelling. Strong data-modelling instincts and comfort with document or NoSQL databases; MongoDB experience is a clear advantage.
* Platform depth. Ability to reason about workflow logic, conditional expressions, and integrations from first principles, not just by copying prior examples.
* Communication. Customer-facing maturity: you can run a workshop, defend a design decision, manage expectations, and say no well.
* Ownership. A track record of owning the technically hardest part of a project and getting it live.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience enabling a partner or delivery ecosystem, or leading a small technical team.
* Familiarity with API design, scripting, or integration middleware.

title: Lead Specialist, Technology Solutions - Agentic Automations
description:
**About Pearson**

  
  

At Pearson, our purpose is simple:
**Add life to a lifetime of learning.**

  
  

As a global leader in digital learning, we are transforming how people learn through innovative, AI-powered experiences that improve outcomes and create meaningful impact. Pearson is embracing a digital-first future where AI, automation, and intelligent systems enable employees to focus on higher-value work while accelerating business transformation.

  
  

The
**Office of the CTO**
powers this transformation by delivering scalable, secure, resilient, and intelligent enterprise platforms. Within Digital & Technology (D&T), the
**AgentOps Team**
leads the next generation of enterprise automation through Agentic AI, intelligent workflows, and autonomous systems that drive measurable business value.

  
  

**Why Join AgentOps?**

  
  

This is an opportunity to be at the forefront of enterprise AI innovation and help shape how humans and AI agents collaborate at scale.

  
  

You will:

  

  
* Build cutting-edge agentic AI solutions deployed across Pearson's global enterprise
  
  
* Create intelligent workflows that combine automation, reasoning, and human oversight
  
  
* Solve high-impact business challenges using advanced AI technologies
  
  
* Influence enterprise-wide AI engineering and automation standards
  
  
* Help define the future of a symbiotic workforce where humans and AI agents work together seamlessly
  

  

**Role Overview**

  
  

The
**Lead Specialist, Agentic Automations**
is a senior practitioner and solution leader responsible for driving the end-to-end discovery, design, and delivery of enterprise-scale Agentic AI and intelligent automation solutions.

  
  

This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, process transformation, and AI engineering. You will work closely with business leaders, architects, engineers, and product teams to identify automation opportunities, design scalable agent ecosystems, and deliver solutions that generate measurable business outcomes.

  
  

As a critical member of AgentOps, you will translate complex business challenges into intelligent, AI-powered workflows while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, governance, risk, compliance, and ROI objectives.

  
  

You will play a key role in advancing Pearson's vision of an AI-enabled enterprise powered by agentic systems and intelligent automation.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  
  

**Business Analysis & Opportunity Discovery**

  

  
* Lead end-to-end requirements gathering, process discovery, and stakeholder workshops for agentic automation initiatives.
  
  
* Analyze business processes to identify opportunities for intelligent automation, autonomous agents, and AI-driven workflow transformation.
  
  
* Facilitate cross-functional discussions with SMEs, product owners, operational teams, and business leaders.
  
  
* Document and validate business requirements, use cases, process maps, and success criteria.
  
  
* Translate business challenges into scalable AI and automation solutions with clearly defined value realization metrics.
  
  
* Establish measurable ROI, productivity, efficiency, quality, and cost optimization objectives.
  

  

**Solution Design & Agentic Architecture**

  

  
* Design intelligent workflows, multi-agent systems, and semi-autonomous business processes.
  
  
* Define agent behaviors, orchestration patterns, decision frameworks, escalation mechanisms, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  
  
* Create comprehensive solution artifacts including:
  
  
* Process Design Documents (PDDs)
  
  
* Solution Design Documents (SDDs)
  
  
* User Journeys
  
  
* Process Flows
  
  
* System Interaction Diagrams
  
  
* Agent Behavior Models
  
  
* Data & Integration Specifications
  
  
* Partner with architects and engineering teams to establish scalable and reusable design patterns.
  
  
* Ensure solutions align with enterprise platform, integration, security, and governance standards.
  

  

**Agentic AI & Automation Delivery**

  

  
* Lead the functional design and implementation of agentic automation solutions.
  
  
* Collaborate with developers, AI engineers, and automation specialists throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  
  
* Design workflows incorporating:
  
  
* Autonomous and semi-autonomous agents
  
  
* Human review and approval stages
  
  
* Escalation paths
  
  
* Exception handling
  
  
* Feedback loops
  
  
* Continuous learning mechanisms
  
  
* Drive adoption of reusable components, templates, skills, prompts, and accelerators across initiatives.
  
  
* Support enterprise rollout, change management, and operational readiness activities.
  

  

**Stakeholder Management & Leadership**

  

  
* Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, delivery teams, and leadership.
  
  
* Communicate solution vision, business value, risks, and implementation approaches to executive and technical audiences.
  
  
* Manage competing priorities and navigate ambiguity in complex transformation programs.
  
  
* Facilitate decision-making and proactively escalate risks, dependencies, and roadblocks.
  
  
* Mentor team members and promote best practices in agentic automation delivery.
  

  

**Responsible AI, Governance & Risk Management**

  

  
* Ensure all solutions comply with Pearson's Responsible AI framework.
  
  
* Implement controls to mitigate:
  
  
* Hallucination risks
  
  
* Prompt injection attacks
  
  
* Data leakage
  
  
* Model misuse
  
  
* Compliance and privacy risks
  
  
* Apply governance requirements based on solution risk levels including low, medium, and high-stakes use cases.
  
  
* Support auditability, explainability, transparency, and regulatory compliance requirements.
  
  
* Partner with security, legal, privacy, and risk teams to ensure enterprise readiness.
  

  

**Delivery Excellence & Business Impact**

  

  
* Partner with program and project managers to ensure successful execution and delivery.
  
  
* Define and track success metrics including:
  
  
* Productivity improvements
  
  
* Cost reduction and avoidance
  
  
* Time savings
  
  
* Automation utilization
  
  
* Employee experience improvements
  
  
* Customer experience outcomes
  
  
* Ensure solutions integrate with enterprise observability, monitoring, telemetry, and governance platforms.
  
  
* Drive continuous optimization through performance measurement and feedback.
  

  

**Innovation & Capability Building**

  

  
* Contribute to Pearson's AgentOps roadmap and enterprise AI strategy.
  
  
* Create and maintain reusable assets including:
  
  
* Prompt libraries
  
  
* Agent templates
  
  
* Automation accelerators
  
  
* Design standards
  
  
* Playbooks and frameworks
  
  
* Evaluate emerging AI, agentic, and automation technologies.
  
  
* Champion an agentic-first mindset and culture of continuous learning across the organization.
  

  

**Technology Ecosystem**

  
  

**Agentic AI & Large Language Models**

  

  
* Azure OpenAI
  
  
* OpenAI APIs
  
  
* Claude
  
  
* Enterprise AI Platforms
  
  
* Multi-Agent Frameworks
  

  

**Automation & Orchestration**

  

  
* UiPath Studio
  
  
* UiPath Orchestrator
  
  
* UiPath Agent Builder
  
  
* UiPath Document Understanding
  
  
* Microsoft Power Automate
  

  

**Data, Integration & Enterprise Platforms**

  

  
* REST APIs
  
  
* JSON / XML
  
  
* OAuth
  
  
* Salesforce
  
  
* ServiceNow
  
  
* Oracle
  
  
* BigQuery
  
  
* OCR & Intelligent Document Processing
  

  

**Engineering & Development**

  

  
* Python
  
  
* JavaScript
  
  
* SQL
  
  
* Git & Version Control
  
  
* AI-Assisted Development Tools (Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot)
  

  

**Required Qualifications**

  
  

**Education**

  

  
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
  
  
* Master's degree preferred but not required.
  

  

**Experience**

  

  
* 8+ years of experience in technology consulting, digital transformation, automation, AI, or enterprise solution delivery.
  
  
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional automation and AI initiatives.
  
  
* Strong experience conducting discovery workshops and translating business requirements into technology solutions.
  
  
* Proven success delivering measurable business outcomes through automation, AI, or enterprise transformation programs.
  

  

**Technical & Functional Expertise**

  
  

Deep understanding of:

  

  
* Agentic AI and autonomous systems
  
  
* Intelligent process automation
  
  
* Enterprise integration patterns
  
  
* Human-in-the-loop workflow design
  
  
* AI governance and Responsible AI principles
  
  
* Enterprise architecture frameworks
  
  
* Business process analysis and optimization
  
  
* Risk management, compliance, and security requirements
  

  

**Leadership Competencies**

  

  
* Strategic thinking and problem solving
  
  
* Exceptional stakeholder management
  
  
* Strong communication and facilitation skills
  
  
* Executive presence and influence
  
  
* Decision-making under ambiguity
  
  
* Collaboration across global and cross-functional teams
  
  
* Continuous learning and innovation mindset
  

  

**Success Measures**

  
  

Success in this role will be measured by:

  

  
* Enterprise adoption of agentic automation solutions
  
  
* Measurable productivity and efficiency gains
  
  
* ROI realization from automation investments
  
  
* Delivery quality and stakeholder satisfaction
  
  
* Reusability and scalability of solutions
  
  
* Compliance with Responsible AI and governance standards
  
  
* Contribution to Pearson's AI and automation transformation agenda
  

  

**Pearson is committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where innovation thrives and every employee can contribute to shaping the future of learning through AI and technology.**

  
  

**Join us in building the future of work, where humans and intelligent agents collaborate to create extraordinary outcomes.**

  
  

**Who we are:**

  
  

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other group protected by law. title: Sr. Solutions Architect - Workday
description:
**Company Overview**
At Zuora, we do Modern Business. We’re helping people subscribe to new ways of doing business that are better for people, companies and ultimately the planet. It’s an approach resulting from the shift to the Subscription Economy that puts customers first by building recurring relationships instead of one-time product sales and focuses on sustainable growth. Through our leading expertise and multi-product suite, we are transforming all industries and working with the world’s most innovative companies to monetize new business models, nurture subscriber relationships and optimize their digital experiences.
  
  
**THE TEAM & ROLE**
Zuora’s Corporate Operations organization serves as the backbone of our internal technology ecosystem, building digital experiences that connect teams, align business priorities, and strengthen collaboration company-wide. Taking a cloud-first, AI-enabled approach, we empower our global ZEOs with modern tools and self-service solutions that drive productivity, scalability, and agility - all while upholding the highest standards of security and compliance.
  
  
Within Corporate Operations, the G&A Business Applications team designs, implements, and optimizes the systems that power all of Zuora's core General & Administrative functions, including Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success (HR), and Legal. Reporting to the Senior Business Systems Manager of Digital Workplace Experience, this team works closely with system analysts, administrators, project managers, data architects, and developers to deliver robust, scalable business solutions.
  
  
The Sr, Solutions Architect - Finance Systems is a senior technical expert and data architect responsible for designing, building, and securing enterprise-grade data structures and integrations across our corporate systems ecosystem. This role functions as a critical cross-functional data and system integration specialist, ensuring seamless data flow, robust security governance, and scalable automation across diverse business platforms (e.g., Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, and more).
  
  
You’ll join a collaborative, high-performing team that values innovation, continuous improvement, and professional growth. Your work will directly impact the efficiency, quality, and scalability of Zuora’s enterprise systems and digital transformation initiatives.
  
  
**YOUR MISSION**
As a senior technical anchor supporting all G&A functions, the Sr, Solutions Architect - Finance Systems collaborates closely with leaders across Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal to establish a cohesive enterprise data architecture. You will build robust system integrations and leverage cutting-edge AI frameworks to drive efficiency, maximize data reliability, and enforce strict compliance across all internal platforms in alignment with strategic goals.
  
  
**YOUR OPPORTUNITY**
As the Sr, Solutions Architect - Finance Systems, you will play a vital role in the development, data architecture, and integration of Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal systems. Combining your expertise as a data architect and multi-platform integration specialist, you’ll ensure seamless data flow, scalable automation, and cross-system reliability without being tied to a single core vendor. You’ll work closely with functional BSAs to prioritize initiatives, refine user stories, and deliver enhancements through agile sprints, while supporting testing and deployment activities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Lead integration support and comprehensive data architecture across core Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal business systems, ensuring cross-platform data consistency and process efficiency.
* Define and maintain end-to-end data models, data lineage, and integration patterns across all G&A applications, establishing a unified "single source of truth" bridging corporate finance, workforce analytics, and legal operations.
* Design, build, and optimize secure, high-performing API-based integrations, microservices, and file-based data flows (REST API, Webhooks, OAuth 2.0, SQL) across Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, and more tools.
* Architect and implement AI-driven automation workflows; evaluate and integrate AI productivity tools and emerging standard frameworks—such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers—to safely expose internal tools and secure data layers to AI agents.
* Enforce strict data security policies, field-level encryption, masking, and access controls across integrated systems to protect sensitive workforce metrics (ZEO Success/PII), legal records, and financial data.
* Collaborate with cross-functional BSAs, business cross functional teams, and security teams using RACI frameworks to clearly map out data ownership, system accountability, and technical execution roles across different departments.
* Ensure configuration standards, technical architecture diagrams, and SOPs are up to date and fully compliant with internal controls, SOX, and global privacy standards (GDPR/CCPA).

**OUR TECH STACK:**
REST API, Webhooks, OAuth 2.0, SQL, JavaScript/Python, Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, AI Automation Tools, and MCP Server frameworks.
  
  
**What You’ll Accomplish**

* Deliver Modern Data Architecture: Transition fragmented cross-system data points from disparate G&A tools into a beautifully mapped out, resilient, and highly secure enterprise data model.
* Excellence in System Integrations: Establish scalable, automated data connections that allow Finance, FP&A, Procurement, HR, and Legal tools to communicate without operational friction, keeping sync latencies low and reliability high.
* Next-Gen Tech Adoption: Successfully implement secure AI extensions or MCP servers to optimize everyday business workflows and scale manual reporting processes down to self-service models.
* Advance Automation & Data Reliability: Develop solutions that strengthen data accuracy, eliminate manual tasks, reduce operational overhead, and increase system reliability across end-to-end business workflows.
* Promote Secure & Compliant Operations: Collaborate with IT, Security, and Audit teams to uphold field-level data protection, access controls, and strict compliance (SOX/GDPR) across all integration data layers.
* Establish Sustainable System Practices: Maintain clear documentation, SOPs, and configuration standards to ensure long-term scalability and consistent cross-functional operational excellence.

**What You’ll Need To Be Successful**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Architecture, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 8+ years of experience in system integrations and backend development (Proficient in REST APIs, SQL, JavaScript/Python, OAuth, and web services).
* Deep hands-on exposure to data structures and integration patterns within modern G&A systems—specifically covering tools across Procurement (Coupa), HR/ATS (Workday, Lattice, Greenhouse), and ERP/Expense (NetSuite, Navan).
* Proven understanding of LLM application patterns, AI integration tools, and modular protocol concepts like Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Solid understanding of data security standards, encryption practices, access control models, and IT/SOX compliance frameworks required when handling sensitive employee, financial, and legal records.
* Strong familiarity with project governance frameworks, including using RACI matrices to clarify cross-team responsibilities.
* Exceptional cross-functional collaboration and communication skills; the ability to elegantly translate complex technical and data architecture blueprints to functional business partners across completely different business disciplines.

**#ZEOLife at Zuora**
As an industry pioneer, our work is constantly evolving and challenging us in new ways that require us to think differently, iterate often and learn constantly—it’s exciting. Our people, whom we refer to as “ZEOs" are empowered to take on a mindset of ownership and make a bigger impact here. Our teams collaborate deeply, exchange different ideas openly and together we’re making what’s next possible for our customers, community and the world.
  
  
As Part Of Our Commitment To Building An Inclusive, High-performance Culture Where ZEOs Feel Inspired, Connected And Valued, We Support ZEOs With
  
  
Competitive compensation, corporate bonus program and performance rewards, company equity and retirement programs
  
  
Medical, dental and vision insurance
  
  
Generous, flexible time off
  
  
Paid holidays, “wellness” days and company wide end of year break
  
  
Learning & Development stipend
  
  
Opportunities to volunteer and give back, including charitable donation match
  
  
Free resources and support for your mental wellbeing
  
  

* Specific benefits offerings may vary by country and can be viewed in more detail during your interview process.

Location & Work Arrangements
  
  
Organizations and teams at Zuora are empowered to design efficient and flexible ways of working, being intentional about scheduling, communication, and collaboration strategies that help us achieve our best results. In our dynamic, globally distributed company, this means balancing flexibility and responsibility — flexibility to live our lives to the fullest, and responsibility to each other, to our customers, and to our shareholders. For most roles, we offer the flexibility to work both remotely and at Zuora offices.
  
  
Our Commitment to an Inclusive Workplace
  
  
Think, be and do you! At Zuora, different perspectives, experiences and contributions matter. Everyone counts. Zuora is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive environment for all.
  
  
Zuora does not discriminate on the basis of, and considers individuals seeking employment with Zuora without regards to, race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.
  
  
We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us by sending an email to assistance@zuora.com.

title: Agentic Full-Stack Engineer
description:
**Agentic Full-Stack Engineer**

**About Securin**

Securin is an AI-native cybersecurity company. Our Preemptive Exposure Management Platform turns exposure data into clear decisions — giving organizations the confidence to know which risks are exploitable, what to fix first, and how to act before attackers do.

**Our Engineering Values**

We build with agents and verify with humans — treating AI as a genuine collaborator, holding agent-generated code to the same review standard as human-authored code, and shipping features only when test coverage and security checks are in place. We take end-to-end ownership, write maintainable code, and bring security awareness into every decision — not as a checkbox, but as a core discipline.

**The Role**

A high-agency software engineer who uses coding agents as a force multiplier: generating design specs with AI, curating those outputs with engineering judgment, and shipping high-quality features at pace on the Securin cybersecurity platform.

**Responsibilities**

● Feature Development

Design and ship full-stack features for the Securin platform end-to-end — using AI coding agents (Claude) to generate specs and boilerplate, then curating those outputs with engineering rigor, security context, and architectural judgment before finalizing. Work with teams in the US and India to facilitate communication, operations, and design. Required to attend 1-2 US evening meetings a week to sync with India based teams.

● Agent & Automation Engineering

Build agentic workflows and automation pipelines that streamline engineering — and enforce a human-in-the-loop review process ensuring every AI-produced change is critically evaluated for correctness, security, and fit before it reaches production.

● Platform & Infrastructure

Architect and maintain cloud-native SaaS services on AWS, contributing to API design, data modeling, and microservices architecture that power real-time threat intelligence ingestion and delivery.

● Security Mindset

Apply secure-by-design principles throughout development and work alongside Securin's security researchers to translate vulnerability intelligence domain knowledge into robust platform capabilities.

**Requirements**

● 3+ years building production SaaS

● Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

● Public cloud experience required (AWS preferred, GCP or Azure acceptable)

● Deep familiarity with:

○ Containerization

○ Serverless architecture

○ Event-driven architecture

○ RESTful API design

**Culture-Forward Building with AI: What We Expect - Role-Specific**

○ Hands-on, daily use of AI coding agents is a prerequisite.

○ Must be able to critically review agent-generated code and specs for:

● Hallucinations

● Security flaws

● Architectural drift before merging.

**General**

Securin is committed to becoming an AI-native organization where GenAI is embedded into how every team works - not just as an occasional assistant, but as a core part of delivery, operations, and how our expertise compounds over time. We expect every employee to actively integrate

**GenAI tools into daily workflows -**
Automating routine tasks, accelerating research and analysis, drafting documents, and building reusable AI-powered processes for their function. You should understand the limitations of GenAI (including inaccuracies and data sensitivity boundaries), follow data classification rules, and continuously improve your AI proficiency. As you grow, we expect you to move beyond using GenAI to building with it - designing agent workflows, contributing reusable skills, and helping Securin compound its Proactive Exposure Management expertise faster than any competitor can replicate.

● Demonstrated ability to use GenAI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) for daily work - drafting, research, summarization, data analysis, code generation, or workflow automation as relevant to the role.

● Working knowledge of GenAI limitations including hallucination risk, context window constraints, and data sensitivity boundaries; ability to validate AI-generated output before acting on it.

● Familiarity with prompt engineering techniques - structuring multi-step instructions, providing context, and iterating on output quality to achieve production-grade results.

● Comfort with agentic AI workflows - using, designing, or building multi-step AI agents that execute tasks autonomously with human-in-the-loop validation.

● Awareness of AI security fundamentals - prompt injection risks, data classification rules, sandboxed execution, and responsible handling of sensitive data in AI workflows.

● Familiarity with connecting GenAI tools to internal data sources, APIs, and enterprise systems.

● Ability to contribute reusable AI skills, templates, agent configurations, or automation workflows to a shared repository for team-wide use.

● Willingness to learn and adopt new AI tools as they evolve; participation in AI adoption sprints, hackathons, and knowledge-sharing within the team.

**Location :**
Remote (For candidates outside Chennai), Hybrid model (2 days a week to office - for candidates from Chennai)

title: Senior Full-Stack Developer
description:
Software Development
  
  
Join Royal York Property Management as a Senior Full-Stack Developer to lead the architecture and maintenance of our key web portals and client applications. Work with cutting-edge AI tools in a remote, dynamic environment.
  
  
**About Royal York Property Management**
At Royal York Property Management, we take pride in managing our clients' investment properties with the same dedication and care as we would our own. Our approach to property management is meticulous, whether it involves addressing maintenance emergencies or conducting tenant showings. In every task, we consider whether the standards we apply are equivalent to those we would expect for our properties. Prioritizing the needs of our clients and tenants is at the forefront of our mission, ensuring we deliver exceptional service every day.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Senior Full-Stack Developer at Royal York Property Management, you will be responsible for architecting, scaling, and maintaining our core web platforms. You will play a vital role in managing complex backend ecosystems using Laravel and dynamic frontends with Vue.js, ensuring seamless integration with third-party APIs like Google Ads and Zoho. Your expertise will guide the development of secure, scalable, and fast-delivery features using AI-assisted coding workflows.
  
  
In your day-to-day, you'll write clean and maintainable backend code, develop reactive UI components, and manage API endpoints and webhooks. You will leverage AI tools to enhance development speed and maintain a robust architectural structure across projects. You will work closely with our technical leads, operating with high autonomy to design and execute high-level project requirements into functional systems.
  
  
Success in this role means delivering modular, scalable features rapidly, achieving zero critical downtime, and ensuring robust security implementations. You'll excel if you take a proactive approach to security, love clean architecture, and possess a flair for integrating AI workflows into traditional coding practices.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Architect and maintain core web portals and client applications using Laravel and Vue.js.
* Write clean, maintainable backend business logic in Laravel and develop reactive UI components in Vue.js.
* Design, test, and monitor external API endpoints, handle incoming and outgoing webhook payloads, and trace debug logs.
* Utilize AI coding assistants to rapidly prototype and refactor code, and write comprehensive test suites.
* Review code architecture, optimize database queries, and ensure security compliance across active projects.
* Deliver major feature sprints, verify webhook reliability, and perform code reviews.
* Conduct security audits, optimize API rate-usage tracking, and update technical documentation.
* Architect new multi-tenant modules, refactor legacy architecture, and troubleshoot complex production scaling bottlenecks.
* Achieve zero critical downtime in production and implement clean API error handling and robust security measures.
* Build and document robust, fault-tolerant API integrations with error recovery and rate-limit handling.
* Deliver scalable, secure, and modular features rapidly using modern AI-assisted development workflows.
* Difficulties arise when handling asynchronous event/APIs, ignoring security fundamentals, or relying on outdated development methods.
* Debug broken or delayed webhook payloads, manage API quota suspensions, and resolve security vulnerabilities under tight deadlines.

What we are looking for
  
  

* Minimum of 6 years of hands-on software development experience building production-grade web applications.
* Deep expertise in PHP and Laravel for backend development. Proficiency in frontend development with a strong grasp of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and familiarity with frameworks and libraries such as Tailwind CSS and Vue.js.
* Extensive experience in REST APIs, OAuth protocols, and Webhooks. Knowledge of various third-party platforms like Payment Gateways, Google Ads, Google Analytics, and Zoho for integrations.
* Strong knowledge of comprehensive web security best practices, including CSRF, XSS protection, secure authentication methods, data encryption, and safe payload validation.
* Proficiency in Git for version control, and experience with deployment on cloud platforms such as AWS and Cloudways.
* Familiarity with SSH and command-line tools for efficient server management and deployment.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* English — fluent, spoken and written.

Nice to have
  
  

* Python proficiency is an advantage, especially for potential integration or data-driven tasks.
* Experience with AI-assisted development tools to enhance coding speed and quality is preferred.

What we offer
  
  
CAD $24,000 to $40,000 per year.
  
  
Schedule
  
  
Full-Time, Mon-Fri, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM.
  
  
What happens next
  
  
Our recruitment partner will be in touch with you about your application.
  
  
If you meet the requirements for the role, they will send you a link to an online video interview that you complete in your own time — there is no appointment to book and nothing to install.
  
  
Your completed interview is then shared with us to review alongside your application, and we will let you know what happens next.

title: Senior Engineer- Dot Net

We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.
  
  
As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.
  
  
**About Energy Systems**
We help customers navigate the complex transition to a decarbonized and more sustainable energy future. We do this by assuring that energy systems work safely and effectively, using solutions that are increasingly digital. We also help industries and governments to navigate the many complex, interrelated transitions taking place globally and regionally, in the energy industry.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Senior Software Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, testing, deploying, and supporting production-grade software products and shared platform capabilities within DNV’s Digital & Transformation organization. This role sits within the Application Engineering section and contributes to the development and modernization of scalable web applications that support digital delivery across Energy Systems.
  
  
This role helps to advance how DNV performs Due Diligence, Verification & Assurance, and Renewables Certification work across Energy Systems.
  
  
This is not a project-based delivery or staff-augmentation role. Engineers are expected to develop deep product knowledge and remain accountable for the quality, maintainability, and operation of the software they build.
  
  
Working in close partnership with Frontend Engineers, Product leadership, Data & AI Engineering, Solution Engineering, Platform Reliability, Solution Architecture, and Platform Security & Compliance, this role helps bring application capabilities, data services, AI-enabled features, workflows, and APIs into one cohesive platform and product experience.
  
  
The Senior Software Engineer designs, builds, tests, deploys, and supports scalable software across a modern Microsoft-oriented full-stack environment. The primary stack includes C# and .NET 10, Entity Framework Core, SignalR, MySQL, Redis, TypeScript, React, Redux, Tailwind CSS, Docker, .NET Aspire, Azure Functions, Azure Storage, Azure AI Search, and Azure DevOps. The role requires strong engineering fundamentals, practical cloud experience, and the ability to collaborate effectively across globally distributed teams.
  
  
This role supports custom software development, application modernization, and integration with low-code or hybrid development environments, helping establish shared patterns, APIs, reusable components, and maintainable application architecture across the platform.
  
  
\*\*This role is based at our DNV office in Chennai, India. Further details regarding role-specific requirements will be shared during the interview process.\*\*
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Software Engineering & Delivery**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable application and platform capabilities using modern software engineering practices.
* Build cohesive product experiences across backend services, APIs and platform integrations.
* Work directly with Product and Architecture stakeholders to shape requirements, evaluate technical approaches, and translate product direction into maintainable, production-ready software.
* Participate actively in code reviews, technical design discussions, estimation, delivery planning, and implementation decisions.
* Write clean, well-structured, testable, and maintainable code that supports long-term product quality and team velocity.
* Own product capabilities through design, implementation, deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and iterative improvement rather than treating delivery as complete when the initial feature is released.
* NET Application Development
* Develop modern API capabilities using C#, .NET 10, Entity Framework Core, SignalR, and related technologies.
* Develop solutions for Azure and contribute to their deployment and support.
* Support application modernization efforts, including refactoring, technical debt reduction, framework upgrades, and migration from legacy patterns where appropriate.
* Develop application capabilities used for structured review workflows, real-time collaboration, issue tracking, customer interaction, reporting, and delivery of technical work products.
* Partner with Product and design stakeholders to ensure application functionality is intuitive, reliable, and aligned with user workflows.
* Develop APIs, backend services, frontend components, and integration patterns that support platform interoperability.
* Help integrate applications with data services, AI-enabled capabilities, workflow configurations, authentication patterns, and enterprise systems.
* Contribute to reusable development patterns, documentation, and engineering practices that improve team velocity and consistency.
* Integrate data-driven, search, agentic, and AI-enabled capabilities into production web applications using well-defined APIs and reusable application patterns.

**Modern Development & AI-Enabled Engineering**

* Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, testing, debugging, documentation, refactoring, and engineering analysis.
* Apply strong engineering judgment when using LLM-enabled workflows, ensuring generated or assisted code meets standards for quality, security, maintainability, and performance.
* Use AI-enabled tools where appropriate to support test generation, code review preparation, technical documentation, and developer productivity.

**DevOps, Reliability & Security**

* Contribute to Azure DevOps repositories and pipelines, automated testing, deployment automation, environment management, monitoring, and incident readiness.
* Build software using an Agile methodology, with strong attention to reliability, performance, availability, scalability, and operational support.
* Support observability practices including logging, monitoring, error handling, and production diagnostics.
* Follow secure development practices aligned with internal security standards, SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and enterprise security expectations.
* Collaborate with Platform Reliability, Security, and Global Shared Services teams to support secure, reliable, and maintainable production systems.

**Collaboration & Technical Ownership**

* Work effectively with Product, Solution Engineering, Data & AI Engineering, Platform Reliability, Architecture, Security, and regional teams in a globally distributed environment.
* Take ownership of assigned features, services, defects, and technical improvements from design through production support.
* Communicate technical trade-offs clearly and contribute to pragmatic engineering decisions.
* Mentor less experienced engineers through code reviews, technical guidance, pairing, and shared engineering practices.
* Contribute to a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and delivery excellence.
* Contribute actively within planning and design meetings, speaking up where potential issues arise or where a requirement is poorly defined.
* Champion potential solutions to problems and communicate them clearly to the team.

What we offer

* Generous Paid Leaves (Annual, Sick, Compassionate, Local Public, Marriage, Maternity, Paternity, Medical leave)
* Medical benefits ( Insurance and Annual Health Check-up)
* Pension and Insurance Policies (Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance, Travel Insurance)
* Training and Development Assistance (Training Sponsorship, On-The-Job Training, Training Programme)
* Additional Benefits (Long Service Awards, Mobile Phone Reimbursement)
* Company bonus/Profit share.

\*Benefits may vary based on position, tenure/contract/grade level\*
  
  
DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.

* 5+ years of experience developing production software in application engineering, software engineering, platform engineering, or related technical roles.
* Strong production experience developing backend applications and services using C# and modern .NET.

* Deep understanding of SQL and database optimisation.
* Experience building, modernizing, or operating scalable web applications in production environments, especially applications that support complex workflows, collaboration, reporting, document review, or customer-facing delivery.
* Experience building APIs, backend services, frontend components, integrations, and application capabilities in production environments.
* Experience developing, deploying, and supporting cloud-hosted applications, with practical experience in Microsoft Azure strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of software design, testing, code quality, maintainability, security, and performance.
* Experience with CI/CD, automated testing, source control, code review, and modern software delivery practices.
* Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted development tools or LLM-enabled coding workflows to improve development productivity.
* Ability to collaborate with Product, Architecture, Security, Platform Reliability, and cross-functional stakeholders in a matrixed environment.
* Strong English communication skills and ability to work effectively across globally distributed teams.

**What Is Preferred**

* Experience in frontend systems such as React or Blazor.
* Experience in product-led or platform-based organizations.
* Familiarity with low-code or hybrid development environments.
* Experience with collaborative due diligence, document review, workflow, reporting, Q&A, risk management, or transaction delivery applications.
* Experience supporting interoperability across multiple systems or enterprise platforms.
* Experience working in a broader multi-cloud enterprise environment, including familiarity with AWS.

Security and compliance with statutory requirements in the countries in which we operate is essential for DNV. Background checks will be conducted on all final candidates as part of the offer process, in accordance with applicable country-specific laws and practices.

title: Associate Senior Solutions Architect - req38675
description:
**Associate Senior Solutions Architect**
Job #: req38675
  
  
Organization: World Bank
  
  
Sector: Information Technology
  
  
Grade: GG
  
  
Term Duration: Open-Ended Staff (OPEN-OP)
  
  
Recruitment Type: Local Recruitment
  
  
Location: Chennai,India
  
  
Required Language(s): English
  
  
**Preferred Language(s)**
Closing Date: 10/30/2026 (MM/DD/YYYY) at 11:59pm UTC
  
  
**Description**
At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https://www.worldbank.org/en/who-we-are/ibrd
  
  
**ITS Vice Presidency Context**
The Information and Technology Solutions (ITS) Vice Presidential Unit (VPU) enables the World Bank Group to achieve its mission of ending extreme poverty and boost shared prosperity on a livable planet by delivering transformative information and technologies to its staff working in over 150+ locations. For more information on ITS, see this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?reload=9&v=VTFGffa1Y7w
  
  
**Department Context**
The ITS Operations Products unit (ITSOP) enables the Bank's operational business processes through modern, flexible and user-friendly digital products. Its portfolio includes Operations Workspace and related solutions that bring together operational data, documents, workflows, collaboration and decision support for front-line staff.
  
  
ITSOP is seeking an Associate Senior Solutions Architect to provide hands-on architecture and engineering leadership for the Operations Workspace ecosystem. The successful candidate will combine deep Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Dataverse expertise with strong .NET and Azure engineering skills, personally implement prototypes and reference solutions, and guide delivery teams from design through production. The role will also help integrate Generative AI and agentic capabilities into operational workflows using a governed AI Development Lifecycle (ADLC). This is not a purely advisory role.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
The Associate Senior Solutions Architect translates complex operational requirements into secure, scalable and maintainable solutions across Dynamics 365, Dataverse, .NET, Azure, APIs, data platforms and AI services. The role defines architecture, validates choices through working code, establishes reusable patterns and guardrails, and remains directly engaged in troubleshooting, CI/CD, release readiness and production improvement.
  
  
**Duties And Accountabilities**
The Associate Senior Solutions Architect works across multiple projects in the World Bank Operations portfolio and is accountable for ensuring that technical solutions are successfully designed, delivered and operated for Operations staff.
  
  
From a work-program perspective, the role provides technical leadership, delivery oversight and practical guidance to internal staff and globally distributed vendor teams. The architect helps sequence technical work, resolves delivery constraints and ensures that implementation remains aligned with business priorities, enterprise standards and release commitments.
  
  
From a technical perspective, the role leads application, integration and data architecture; identifies solution components and reusable patterns; validates designs through working prototypes; performs quality and code reviews; and remains accountable for delivery at speed, scale and quality.
  
  
**Role Scope and Distinction**

* Acts as a senior technical subject matter expert for complex, business-critical solutions in the Operations Workspace portfolio.
* Balances strategic architecture with recent, demonstrable hands-on contribution to prototypes, code, integration, deployment and technical problem-solving.
* Leads cross-layer design decisions involving applications, workflows, data, APIs, identity, security, observability and AI-enabled experiences.
* Guides multidisciplinary teams and vendors, mentors architects and engineers, and raises engineering quality through practical standards and reusable implementation assets.
* Works across globally distributed business, product, architecture, security, data, platform and engineering stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Architecture and Technical Leadership**

* Lead end-to-end solution architecture for Operations Workspace and related products, aligning business outcomes, enterprise principles, security requirements and delivery constraints.
* Define target-state and transition architectures, solution options, architecture decision records, integration contracts, non-functional requirements and implementation roadmaps.
* Review designs and code for scalability, resilience, maintainability, interoperability, usability, performance and cost effectiveness.
* Identify systemic risks and technical debt, propose pragmatic remediation, and guide Agile Release Train and product teams through implementation trade-offs.

Lead solution delivery teams through implementation, maintenance, release readiness and operational improvement of business-critical applications supporting Operations Workspace and related Operations product ecosystems.
  
  
Lead application and data architecture modelling, component identification and solution quality reviews, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture principles and approved technology standards.
  
  
**Dynamics 365 and Dataverse Engineering**

* Architect and implement Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Dataverse solutions, including data models, security roles, business rules, workflows, plug-ins, custom actions, Power Platform components and environment strategy.
* Design supported extension patterns using C#/.NET, the Dataverse SDK and APIs while minimizing fragile customization and preserving upgradeability.
* Guide integration of Dynamics 365 with SharePoint Online, Microsoft Graph, Azure services, enterprise data products and other operational systems.
* Define application lifecycle management practices for solutions, configuration, environment variables, connection references, test data and controlled promotion across environments.

**Hands-on Prototyping and .NET Engineering**

* Personally design, code, test and demonstrate proofs of concept, technical spikes, reference implementations and minimum viable solutions.
* Develop secure APIs, services, plug-ins and integration components using C#, modern .NET, ASP.NET Core and RESTful patterns.
* Validate architecture choices through executable prototypes, performance tests and failure-mode testing before major delivery investment.
* Troubleshoot complex issues across user experience, application, integration, identity, data and infrastructure layers, and support teams during critical releases.

**Integration, Cloud and Platform Architecture**

* Design API-led, event-driven and workflow-based integrations using appropriate Azure services, API management, messaging, serverless and container patterns.
* Apply identity-first design using Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, least privilege, secrets management and auditable authorization patterns, including B2E and approved external-access scenarios.
* Define observability using structured logging, distributed tracing, metrics, dashboards and actionable alerts across application and integration components.
* Collaborate with data and platform teams to connect operational applications to governed data services, analytics products and structured and unstructured enterprise information.

Design integrations with institutional systems and data platforms, including financing, trust funds, board operations, budgeting, SAP and enterprise data services, using supported APIs, events and workflow patterns.
  
  
Architect document and content-management integrations across Dynamics 365, SharePoint Online and approved cloud services, including secure storage, metadata, retrieval and downstream AI processing.
  
  
**Agentic AI and AI-enabled Operations**

* Design and prototype AI-enabled features and agentic workflows embedded in Operations Workspace, with explicit task boundaries, approved tools, controlled permissions, human review and failure handling.
* Integrate agents with Dynamics 365, enterprise APIs, documents, data platforms and business workflows using secure tool calling, structured outputs and reusable orchestration patterns.
* Apply retrieval-augmented generation, document intelligence and knowledge-grounding approaches where they improve operational workflows and decision support.
* Define evaluation, telemetry and guardrails for groundedness, task success, safety, latency, reliability and cost, and ensure Responsible AI, privacy, records and security requirements are addressed.

Partner with information security teams on architecture reviews, threat modelling, control implementation, security testing and remediation evidence required for production approval.
  
  
**Delivery Lifecycle, CI/CD and Engineering Excellence**

* Establish and improve CI/CD pipelines for Dynamics 365 solutions, .NET services, infrastructure configuration and AI components using Azure DevOps or equivalent enterprise tooling.
* Embed automated unit, integration, contract, security, regression and performance testing into delivery pipelines, with quality gates, approvals, release evidence and rollback approaches.
* Apply both the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and a governed AI Development Lifecycle (ADLC), covering use-case framing, data and grounding readiness, prompt and tool versioning, evaluation, deployment, monitoring and change control.
* Create reusable templates, starter repositories, SDKs, reference pipelines, coding standards and implementation guidance that improve developer productivity and consistency.

**Stakeholder, Vendor and Team Leadership**

* Translate operational needs into feasible technical choices and communicate architecture decisions and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Provide practical technical direction to internal teams and vendors, review deliverables against agreed architecture and quality expectations, and intervene hands-on where necessary.
* Mentor architects and engineers through pairing, design reviews, code reviews, demonstrations and knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Partner with product leadership to sequence enablers, reduce delivery risk and ensure technical work results in measurable operational value.

Provide work-program oversight for internal and vendor delivery teams across locations, assess deliverable quality, remove technical blockers and hold suppliers accountable for agreed architecture, engineering and documentation standards.
  
  
Selection Criteria
  
  

* Master's degree with at least eight years of relevant experience, or bachelor's degree with at least ten years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience, in computer science, software engineering, information systems or a related field.
* Substantial recent experience architecting and delivering large-scale enterprise applications using Microsoft Dynamics 365, Dataverse, .NET and Azure.

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**AI Business Solutions – Dynamics F&SCM Commerce Technical Senior :**
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As a Microsoft Dynamics 365 Commerce Technical Senior at EY GDS, you will contribute to the success of enterprise-scale D365 F&O implementations, primarily in the Retail and commerce domain. You will have the opportunity to work with a growing team and play a key role in delivering financial transformation solutions, process improvements, and ERP implementations to global clients, helping build a better working world.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain strong client relationships through value-driven consulting, technical leadership, and proactive engagement.
* Lead the technical design and development of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Commerce solutions, with a focus on POS systems (MPOS/CPOS) & B2C /B2B Website.
* Configure and extend Store Commerce, Hardware Station, and integrate peripherals such as printers, scanners, cash drawers, and payment devices.
* Configure and extend B2C & B2B website, Site builder.
* Develop custom POS functionalities using Commerce SDK, Online SDK , TypeScript, JavaScript, C#, and .NET Core.
* Implement integrations between POS and backend systems: ERP (F&O), payment gateways, fiscal printers, loyalty programs, and eCommerce platforms.
* Design and maintain offline-first POS architecture, ensuring performance, fault tolerance, and scalability across store networks.
* Collaborate with functional consultants to translate business needs into detailed technical designs and functional design documents (FDDs).
* Utilize Azure DevOps and Lifecycle Services (LCS) for source control, CI/CD pipelines, and environment management.
* Support system testing, performance tuning, deployment, and go-live activities.
* Conduct code reviews, enforce best development practices, and maintain thorough technical documentation.
* Provide Level 3 support post-go-live to resolve POS-related issues and ensure smooth store operations.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Familiarity with Power Platform, especially Power Apps and Power BI, is a plus.
* Ability to conceptualize and design future-state business processes.
* Experience in conducting GAP analysis, solution testing, and user training.
* Good understanding of security roles, data management, Azure DevOps, and LCS environments.

**Ideally, you’ll also**

* Knowledge of integration with other Microsoft technologies such as Azure, Power Platform.
* Familiarity with industry-specific retail practices and compliance requirements.
* Experience working in multi-country and multi-legal entity environments.
* Strong documentation, stakeholder communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Proven ability to lead discovery workshops, manage offshore teams, and mentor junior consultants.
* A proactive mindset with the ability to work independently and collaboratively in a global, fast-paced environment.

**What We Look For**

* 5–10 years of experience in D365 Commerce technical.
* Minimum 3 full-cycle D365 F&O implementations in Commerce domains.
* Strong domain knowledge of Retail & eCommerce
* Strong domain knowledge of D365 Site builder tool
* Strong analytical and debugging skills with a focus on performance and reliability.
* Experience with Microsoft SureStep, Agile, or hybrid implementation methodologies.
* Proficiency in working with globally distributed teams and stakeholders.
* Microsoft certifications such as MB-340, MB-900 are preferred.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
