title: Senior Software Engineer – (Java Full Stack)
description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.
  
  
**A Day In The Life (Responsibilities)**

* Independently design and implement well-defined features across the full stack with minimal day-to-day guidance.
* Collaborate with Product Managers, UX designers, QA, and fellow engineers to translate requirements into working software.
* Develop and maintain frontend features using React or Angular, focusing on usability and performance.
* Contribute to backend services using Java, Kotlin, or .NET (expertise in one is sufficient; .NET is not mandatory).
* Build and consume RESTful APIs and integrate with internal systems.
* Write clean, maintainable, and testable code aligned with Toast engineering standards.
* Participate actively in code reviews—both receiving and providing constructive feedback.
* Troubleshoot production and non-production issues within owned areas and contribute to root-cause analysis.
* Use Gradle or Maven, Git, and standard development workflows effectively.
* Apply AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Devin) to improve development speed and quality.
* Support team delivery during critical phases when needed, including production issues and urgent fixes.
* Consistently delivers on commitments with predictable cycle time for scoped work.
* Demonstrates ownership of components or features but does not yet own large systems end-to-end.
* Understands and follows established architectural patterns and engineering best practices.
* Proactively communicates progress, risks, and dependencies.
* Seeks feedback and continuously improves technical depth and execution quality.

**What you'll need to thrive (Requirements):**

* A minimum of Bachelor’s degree in any area, or any other related discipline.
* 6+ years of experience in software or full-stack development.
* Strong hands-on experience with frontend frameworks such as React or Angular.
* Solid backend development experience in Java, Kotlin, or .NET.
* Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs.
* Proficiency with Git and modern branching workflows.
* Working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases, including basic schema design and querying.
* Experience with cloud platforms, preferably AWS.
* Familiarity with Gradle or Maven for build and dependency management.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams.
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to code quality.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills.

**Nice-to-Have**

* Exposure to AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Devin).
* Basic understanding of CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows.
* Experience working in a large-scale SaaS or product engineering environment.

**AI at Toast**
At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.
  
  
**Our Total Rewards Philosophy**
We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast-benefits.
  
  
**How Toast Uses AI In Its Hiring Process**
Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more: https://careers.toasttab.com/ai-in-hiring
  
  
**Our Approach to Hybrid Working**
We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region: https://careers.toasttab.com/locations-toast
  
  
**People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success**
At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry brings together people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value that same breadth at Toast. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work—raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other.
  
  
**Apply today!**
Toast is committed to creating an accessible and inclusive hiring process. As part of this commitment, we strive to provide reasonable accommodations for persons with disabilities to enable them to access the hiring process. If you need an accommodation to access the job application or interview process, please contact candidateaccommodations@toasttab.com.
  
  
*For roles in the United States, it is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.*

title: Sitecore Development Lead
description:
**Job Family**
Software Application & Development (India)
  
  
**Travel Required**
None
  
  
**Clearance Required**
None
  
  
**What You Will Do**
We are seeking a Sitecore Developer to build, enhance, and support our enterprise digital experience platform, with a strong focus on SitecoreAI-enabled development. In this role, you will translate business, content, and design requirements into secure, scalable, and high-performing Sitecore solutions; develop reusable components, integrations, and AI-assisted capabilities; and help ensure reliable releases. You will work closely with the Sitecore Architect, developers, content teams, marketing stakeholders, analytics teams, and external partners to deliver maintainable experiences using Sitecore XM Cloud, SitecoreAI, React, Next.js, the Sitecore Content SDK, GraphQL, Experience Edge, Vercel, and modern cloud delivery practices.
  
  

* Develop reusable, accessible headless components and intuitive authoring experiences that translate approved designs into maintainable application code.
* Build and integrate SitecoreAI capabilities that improve content creation, content discovery, search relevance, personalization, and digital experience delivery while following approved governance and security standards.
* Configure content models, templates, validation rules, metadata, and publishing workflows in partnership with content owners, with clear documentation for authors and support teams.
* Develop and maintain integrations with enterprise platforms, including CRM, CDP, analytics, identity, consent management, search, marketing automation, and approved AI services.
* Collaborate with the Sitecore Architect and delivery partners on technical designs, implementation standards, AI development patterns, platform governance, and release planning.
* Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly to accelerate coding, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and content operations while validating outputs for accuracy, security, performance, accessibility, and maintainability.
* Participate in code reviews, automated testing, deployment coordination, and production readiness activities; provide practical guidance to other developers when needed.
* Optimize application performance, accessibility, security, SEO, AEO, GEO, caching, search discoverability, and content delivery across environments.
* Diagnose and resolve complex defects and production issues involving rendering, APIs, integrations, AI-enabled features, and content delivery using logs, monitoring, and root-cause analysis.
* Contribute to cloud and hosting decisions related to scalability, resilience, observability, and cost efficiency within the established architecture.
* Implement approved personalization capabilities and privacy-conscious analytics events, including GA4 event contracts, in coordination with analytics and integration teams.
* Identify and recommend improvements to development practices, AI tooling, prompt and evaluation approaches, documentation, and platform capabilities that increase quality and delivery efficiency.

**What You Will Need**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* At least 4 years of software development experience, including hands-on delivery of Sitecore-based digital platforms in enterprise environments.
* Hands-on experience developing headless Sitecore XM Cloud solutions using React, Next.js, Sitecore JSS or the Sitecore Content SDK, Experience Edge, and Vercel.
* Experience implementing or extending SitecoreAI features, AI-assisted content workflows, intelligent search or discovery, personalization, or related generative AI capabilities within a digital experience platform.
* Proficiency with JavaScript or TypeScript, component-based development, HTML, CSS, REST APIs, GraphQL, and integration patterns for approved AI services.
* Experience with content modeling, templates, component configuration, metadata, publishing workflows, and authoring experiences in Sitecore.
* Working knowledge of Sitecore Helix principles, headless implementation patterns, composable DXP architecture, and responsible AI development practices.
* Ability to design prompts, structured inputs, guardrails, and practical evaluation scenarios for AI-enabled features, and to assess outputs for quality, relevance, accuracy, privacy, and security.
* Experience with Git-based development, pull requests, automated testing, and CI/CD deployment practices.
* Experience integrating Sitecore with third-party and enterprise systems, such as analytics, identity, CRM, consent management, search, marketing platforms, or AI services.
* Ability to diagnose application, rendering, caching, API, deployment, AI integration, and content-delivery issues across environments.
* Understanding of web security, data privacy, accessibility, scalability, performance optimization, SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), and generative engine optimization (GEO).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical and AI-related decisions to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and collaborate effectively in a hybrid, cross-functional delivery environment.
* Ability to support peers through code reviews, troubleshooting, documentation, and knowledge sharing while aligning with the Sitecore Architect’s technical direction.

**What Would Be Nice To Have**

* Experience with additional Sitecore products, such as Content Hub, Search, CDP, Personalize, or SXA.
* Experience developing with large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, AI APIs, or agent-based workflows in an enterprise environment.
* Familiarity with AI evaluation, prompt management, content governance, responsible AI principles, and monitoring of AI-enabled experiences.
* Experience delivering solutions on Microsoft Azure or another major cloud platform.
* Familiarity with automated unit, integration, accessibility, performance, and visual regression testing.
* Sitecore certification or equivalent demonstrated expertise.
* Experience working in regulated, high-traffic, or complex enterprise environments.
* Strong presentation and stakeholder management skills.

**About Guidehouse India**
At Guidehouse India, we’re redefining what’s possible by creating opportunities that change lives. Guidehouse is a global professional services firm that delivers advisory, technology, and managed services to clients across both the commercial and public sectors. Our teams turn bold ideas into solutions that transform industries, strengthen communities, and drive meaningful impact worldwide.
  
  
Across our Chennai, Trivandrum, and Gurugram locations, you’ll find opportunities where your passion and curiosity help shape what comes next. With cutting edge benefits, innovative learning and development programs, and a people first culture, we empower our people to lead with purpose.
  
  
We continue to expand our teams and capabilities across India, investing in state-of-the-art offices and high impact work. description:

****Job Description:****
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
Role Definition
  
  
Develop, maintain, and modernize Java and Angular-based enterprise applications by transforming traditional Agile software development practices into an Agentic SDLC using Caterpillar-approved AI frameworks, development tools, and governance standards to accelerate solution delivery, improve software quality, and enhance engineering productivity.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, implement, and maintain enterprise software applications using Agile and Agentic Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) practices, leveraging Caterpillar-approved AI frameworks, tools, and engineering standards.
* Collaborate with business partners and stakeholders to capture requirements, refine user stories, and optimize business workflows through intelligent automation and AI-assisted solution design.
* Develop, enhance, and maintain application code using AI-assisted development tools, including generation, review, refactoring, documentation, and optimization of software components.
* Utilize agentic development frameworks and automated testing tools to accelerate test creation, validation, quality assurance, deployment, and ongoing application maintenance.
* Leverage AI agents throughout the SDLC to support requirements analysis, architecture design, code generation, testing, documentation, DevOps, and production support activities.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity, software quality, and delivery velocity through the adoption of agentic development practices and intelligent automation.
* Assists clients with implementing new products, new releases and software upgrades. Responds to inquiries and requests from clients.
* Participates in analysis of client identified issues or problems which may require changes to software, procedures, or documentation.
* Diagnoses, troubleshoots and resolves common technical problems. Escalates as per procedures.

Skill Descriptors
  
  
Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Reviews others' writing or presentations and provides feedback and coaching.
* Adapts documents and presentations for the intended audience.
* Demonstrates both empathy and assertiveness when communicating a need or defending a position.
* Communicates well downward, upward, and outward.
* Employs appropriate methods of persuasion when soliciting agreement.
* Maintains focus on the topic at hand.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Identifies and documents specific problems and resolution alternatives.
* Examines a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder.
* Develops alternative techniques for assessing accuracy and relevance of information.
* Helps to analyze risks and benefits of alternative approaches and obtain decision on resolution.
* Uses fact-finding techniques and diagnostic tools to identify problems.

Customer Support Policies, Standards and Procedures: Knowledge of the organization's customer support policies, standards and procedures; ability to guide customers on all company interactions.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Collaborates with other functions on establishing and documenting joint standards.
* Develops quality assurance and monitoring mechanisms.
* Advises on the development of customer support policies and practices.
* Implements cross-functional standards and procedures.
* Evaluates the impact of standards and policies across functional specialties.
* Analyzes existing and evolving procedures for their efficiency and effectiveness.

Software Product Technical Knowledge: Knowledge of technical aspects of a software products; ability to design, configure and integrate technical aspects of software products.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Supports and participates in major installations and customizations.
* Has knowledge of all technical and infrastructure components of the software product.
* Maintains and disseminates information on customer platforms and experiences.
* Collects, documents and maintains product configuration requirements and instances.
* Provides recommendations and documentation to field support on technical and platform issues.
* Elaborates on alternative product configurations, platforms, and implementation options.

Software Release Management: Knowledge of strategies, practices and tools for managing versions and distribution of software products and enhancements; ability to evaluate and improve release management practices and tools.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Participates in the development and testing of back-out procedures and recovery strategies.
* Oversees all aspects of release management for the entire installed customer base.
* Develops and disseminates communications about new release training.
* Drafts communications about product release delays.
* Develops distribution dates based on development, testing (QA), validation, packaging activities.
* Conducts impact analysis for major releases or critical applications; assesses benefits and risks.

Software Reliability Management: Knowledge of software reliability management; ability to develop and use principles, methodologies and metrics that increase software product performance and reliability.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Explains the process and considerations for defining product reliability requirements.
* Describes tools for gathering reliability information on installed products.
* Identifies reliability activities and tasks for the product development and maintenance plans.
* Monitors and analyzes system failures and corrective actions.
* Works with reliability testing methods and tools.

Performance Measurement and Tuning: Knowledge of system performance, testing and programming; ability to monitor, measure, and optimize system performance and network communication.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Monitors the performance of specific system components.
* Researches performance objectives and requirements for a component or application.
* Works with installed software tools for performance monitoring and reporting.
* Validates performance characteristics for specific technologies.
* Works with the performance measurements of hardware, software or network components.Technical Troubleshooting: Knowledge of technical troubleshooting approaches, tools and techniques; ability to anticipate, recognize, and resolve technical issues on hardware, software, application or operation.

**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Emphasizes the business impact of failure and the criticality and timing of needed resolution so that problems can be avoided in the future.
* Creates trouble reports for all issues found and reviews solutions for completeness and correctness.
* Directs the resolution of communications problems in multi-vendor environments.
* Resolves a variety of hardware, software, and communications malfunctions.
* Coaches others on advanced diagnostic techniques and tools for unusual or performance-related problems.
* Facilitates the distribution of releases reports and correction packages to departments or clients.

title: Java Angular Full Stack Development Lead - Vice President
description:
The
**Full Stack Development Lead Analyst (Digital Software Engineering Lead)**
is a senior technical and people leadership professional who drives end-to-end engineering excellence, architecture, and delivery across web, mobile, API, microservices, and AI-enabled digital ecosystems. This role acts as a recognized technical authority and managerial leader, steering application development strategy with deep hands-on expertise in
**Java**
,
**Angular**
,
**Microservices architectures**
,
**REST/GraphQL APIs**
,
**Mobile/Web platforms**
, and
**modern AI engineering tools & GenAI integrations**
.
  
  
The role combines strategic direction, architectural governance (Next Gen Architecture / NGA), hands-on technical mentoring, and engineering team leadership. The Lead Manager guides cross-functional engineering teams, promotes the adoption of AI-assisted software development practices (e.g., AI coding assistants, automated test generation, and GenAI gateway/model integrations), collaborates closely with Product Managers, Technical Program Managers (TPMs), and Enterprise Architects, and influences stakeholders across lines of business (LOBs) to deliver scalable, secure, and resilient digital solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Technical Leadership & Full Stack Engineering Delivery
* End-to-End Full Stack Ownership: Lead the design, development, testing, and deployment of mission-critical, enterprise-grade web and mobile applications powered by modern Java microservices backends and Angular frontends.
* Architecture & Modernization: Drive adoption of Next Gen Architecture (NGA) and Plan of Record (POR) standards across microservices, distributed caching, event-driven systems (Kafka/MQ), and cloud-native container platforms.
* API Strategy & Integration: Architect robust, secure, and scalable RESTful and GraphQL APIs, ensuring adherence to enterprise API lifecycle standards, versioning, security protocols (OAuth2/OIDC, mTLS), and API gateway patterns.
* Web & Mobile Development Leadership: Guide teams in building high-performance, responsive web applications in Angular (TypeScript, RxJS, NgRx/State Management) and modern mobile experiences (native/hybrid/responsive mobile frameworks), ensuring seamless cross-platform performance and accessibility (WCAG).
* Delivery Management: Serve as development lead and engineering manager for multiple concurrent large-scale digital initiatives, establishing clear delivery roadmaps, managing technical debt, and resolving complex cross-team dependencies across Agile and hybrid delivery models.
* AI-Assisted Engineering & Innovation
* AI Tooling & SDLC Productivity: Champion and drive team adoption of generative AI developer tools and AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, AI code review and test generation tools) to enhance developer productivity, code quality, and time-to-market.
* GenAI & LLM Integration: Guide architectural patterns for integrating GenAI capabilities, LLM endpoints, semantic search/vector retrieval, AI gateways, and prompt-driven microservices into enterprise web and mobile applications.
* AI Governance & Quality Gates: Ensure that AI-generated code, prompt structures, and GenAI integrations adhere to firm-wide security, privacy, guardrails, compliance, and IP protection standards.
* Architecture Governance, Design & Code Reviews
* Design Review Board & Patterns: Act as a core member of the Design Review Board to evaluate system architectures, establish generic reusable design patterns, and enforce enterprise CTO guidelines across digital domains.
* Code & Quality Governance: Champion rigorous code reviews for Java microservices, Angular applications, mobile modules, and CI/CD pipelines, ensuring high code quality, security posture (SAST/DAST/OSS scanning), performance benchmarking, and test coverage.
* Metrics & Observability: Establish and track clear engineering metrics covering code review thoroughness, CI/CD deployment velocity, test automation coverage, production defect leakage, AI tool adoption gains, and design pattern adoption.
* Resource & Performance Optimization: Direct engineering teams in designing systems optimized for runtime performance, memory footprints, thread management, database query efficiency, low-latency API response times, and high-concurrency workloads.
* Team Management, Coaching & Stakeholder Alignment
* People Leadership & Mentorship: Lead, coach, and empower Software Development Engineers (SDEs), tech leads, and full stack teams, fostering an inclusive culture of continuous learning, engineering craftsmanship, and innovation.
* Stakeholder & Risk Management: Partner with business owners, TPMs, and Product Managers to assess technical and schedule risks, evaluate trade-offs between delivery timelines and architectural runway, and communicate complex risks clearly to executive stakeholders.
* Issue & Blocker Resolution: Proactively anticipate bottlenecks, drive escalation management, mitigate multi-level delivery risks, and facilitate constructive technical dialogues to resolve discordant viewpoints.
* Governance, Risk & Controls
* Risk & Compliance Safeguarding: Appropriately assess risk in all technical and architectural decisions, safeguarding the firm’s assets, client data, and reputation.
* Policy Compliance: Ensure strict adherence to information security standards, data privacy laws, regulatory mandates, cryptographic standards, AI usage policies, and secure SDLC controls, escalating and reporting issues with complete transparency.

**Qualifications & Skills**
**Experience & Education**

* Experience: 10–12+ years of progressive software development experience with at least 3–5 years in a technical leadership / engineering management role driving full stack, microservices, and mobile/web development.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.

**Core Technical Competencies**

* Backend & Microservices:

+ Deep expertise in Java (Java 17/21), Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Hibernate/JPA, and microservices design patterns (Circuit Breaker, Saga, CQRS, Event Sourcing).
+ Solid background in distributed messaging systems (e.g., Apache Kafka, IBM MQ, RabbitMQ).
+ Experience with SQL (Oracle, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis) databases, schema design, and query optimization.

* Frontend & Web Development:

+ Advanced proficiency in Angular (v14+), TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, SCSS/CSS3, and state management (NgRx/RxJS).
+ Strong understanding of modern frontend build tools, micro-frontends architecture, web performance tuning, and cross-browser/responsive UI design.

* API & Integration:

+ Proven track record designing and securing RESTful APIs, OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, GraphQL, and integration with API Gateways.

* Mobile Development Experience:

+ Solid understanding of mobile application architecture (iOS/Android native integration, hybrid frameworks, responsive web/PWA), mobile security best practices, and mobile API orchestration (BFF patterns).

* AI Tools & GenAI Integration (Preferred / Desired):

+ Practical exposure to AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, AI coding assistants, automated unit test generators, AI code review tools).
+ Familiarity with integrating GenAI APIs/LLM endpoints, AI gateways, prompt engineering patterns, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) concepts, or intelligent chat/search capabilities into enterprise applications.
+ Awareness of AI governance, data privacy, and security guardrails for enterprise AI usage.

* Cloud & DevOps:

+ Experience deploying containerized workloads on Kubernetes / Red Hat OpenShift / Docker and public/private cloud environments (AWS, Cloud Foundry, Akamai).
+ Proficiency in CI/CD pipeline automation (Tekton, Jenkins, Harness, GitLab CI), automated testing frameworks (JUnit, Mockito, Jasmine, Karma, Cypress, Selenium), and static code analysis (SonarQube, Snyk, Checkmarx).

**Leadership & Soft Skills**

+ Proven track record of guiding cross-functional teams without direct authority in matrixed enterprise environments.
+ Strong negotiation, diplomacy, and executive presentation skills to communicate technical concepts to non-technical business partners.
+ Strategic mindset with the ability to define technical roadmaps while remaining capable of deep-diving into architecture and code.

**real-world ERP development experience**

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
Consultant, Full Stack Engineer - Java Backend
  
  
Deloitte Consulting Products (USI)
  
  
**About The Role**
Join a collaborative team delivering production-grade web applications that create real business impact. As a Consultant , you will design and build enterprise-scale solutions across both backend and frontend, with a focus on API development and seamless integration. You’ll use modern AI tools to boost productivity, work with technologies like Docker for deployment, and help guide projects from planning to delivery. This role offers a chance to work on innovative projects blending predictive analytics and cutting-edge technology, while mentoring junior engineers and partnering with global teams.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure, and high-quality web applications across backend and frontend.
* Translate Figma or similar UI designs to functional features using React.js, NextJs , and TypeScript.
* Build and operate RESTful APIs and services using Java (Spring Boot or similar), including robust authentication and security integrations (OAuth2/JWT, mTLS , etc.).
* Integrate frontend components with backend logic via secure APIs.
* Containerize applications using Docker and optionally orchestrate with Kubernetes.
* Implement and enforce best practices for testing (JUnit, Jest), code quality, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Optimize for performance and scalability across the full stack.
* Work closely with DevOps, data scientists, and product managers to ship features efficiently.
* Actively use and promote advanced AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, ChatGPT plugins) to improve development productivity.
* Mentor team members and contribute to a collaborative, innovation-driven engineering culture.

Reporting Relationships
  
  
Reports to a Senior Consultant or Manager within IDT. Liaises with onsite/offshore teams to understand functional requirements and may mentor or direct junior team members on a need basis.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required
  
  

* 3 to 5 years of professional experience in full stack engineering roles.
* Expert-level experience in Java( 8+) for backend development, must have shipped production APIs using Spring Boot or similar frameworks.
* Strong frontend skills: React.js, NextJs , TypeScript, Material UI/component libraries.
* Demonstrated use of AI-oriented development tools and plugins (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI).
* Deep experience with Docker, Git, automated testing frameworks, and CI/CD tooling.
* Strong understanding of data persistence, including RDBMS & SQL (or NoSQL), normalization, complex query troubleshooting, and ORM/JPA (e.g., Hibernate) for performant and transactional data access.
* Familiarity with PostgreSQL/SQL and caching (e.g., Redis).
* Cloud experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP is a plus.
* Excellent problem-solving, communication, and team collaboration skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science , Engineering, or related technical field.

**Preferred**

* Experience in agentic/AI-driven architectures or workflow orchestration.
* Familiarity with artifact management (e.g., JFrog ), DevOps toolchain, and secure code/container practices.
* Knowledge of secrets managers, such as Doppler, and code/documentation tools.
* Working experience with Node/Python/. NET-related frameworks.

Why This Role Matters
  
  
This role helps turn complex business needs into secure, scalable web applications that teams can rely on. By combining the technical capabilities outlined above with collaborative delivery practices, the Consultant contributes directly to reliable product outcomes and effective teamwork.
  
  
**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**

EBeam’s mission encapsulates its role as the “eyes” of KLA’s product line, providing timely information on defects and critical locations on the wafer at the highest spatial resolution possible. Customers use EBeam products alongside KLA patterned and bare wafer inspectors to quickly understand the nature of defects and other imperfections on product wafers and take action to correct the manufacturing process.

**Responsibilities:**

* Collaborate with globally distributed teams, including hardware, optics, algorithms, and systems engineers, to deliver high‑impact AI solutions

* Drive model performance tuning, robustness, and explainability to meet manufacturing and customer requirements

title: Celigo Integration Specialist
description:
**Position: Celigo Integration Specialist**
 Location: Chennai \- Onsite/Hybrid/Remote
   

 Shift Timing: 7\.00AM \- 4\.00PM PST (US Pacific Time)
   

  

**About the role:** 
 We are looking for an experienced Celigo Integration Specialist with strong hands\-on expertise in NetSuite integrations. The ideal candidate should have a solid understanding of both NetSuite and the Celigo Integration Platform and be capable of designing, developing, troubleshooting, and supporting integrations between NetSuite and third\-party business applications. The consultant will be responsible for building and maintaining integrations between NetSuite and Stripe, ADP, Bill.com, and Salesforce, ensuring reliable data synchronization and smooth end\-to\-end business processes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Design, develop, configure, and maintain Celigo integrations with NetSuite.
* Build and support integrations between NetSuite and: Stripe, ADP, Bill.com, Salesforce
* Analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into integration solutions.
* Configure Celigo flows, mappings, transformations, filters, lookups, error handling, and scheduling.
* Develop and troubleshoot NetSuite SuiteScript\-based integrations where required.
* Work with NetSuite records, saved searches, custom records, workflows, and APIs.
* Configure and consume REST/SOAP APIs and third\-party APIs.
* Monitor integration jobs and proactively troubleshoot failures and data synchronization issues.
* Perform data mapping and transformation between NetSuite and external applications.
* Implement appropriate error handling, retry mechanisms, logging, and reconciliation processes.
* Work with business and technical teams to understand integration requirements.
* Document integration architecture, configurations, mappings, and operational procedures.
* Support production issues and provide root\-cause analysis for integration failures.
* Ensure integrations are scalable, secure, and maintainable.


**Required Skills:**
**Must Have:**
* Strong hands\-on experience with Celigo Integration Platform.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Oracle NetSuite.
* Experience developing and supporting NetSuite–Celigo integrations.
* Experience with APIs, particularly REST and SOAP.
* Strong understanding of integration patterns, data mapping, transformation, and error handling.
* Experience with NetSuite objects, records, Saved Searches, and SuiteScript.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.


**Integration Experience:**
* Hands\-on experience integrating NetSuite with one or more of the following is required, with preference for candidates who have worked with multiple systems:
* Stripe – payment transactions, customers, invoices, refunds, payment status, etc.
* ADP – employee/payroll\-related data synchronization.
* Bill.com – vendors, bills, payments, and accounting\-related data.
* Salesforce – customers/accounts, opportunities, orders, invoices, and related CRM/financial data.

title: Java full stack developer with react experience
description:
Job Description
 



  





 We are seeking a Java Developer (React Experience) to build and enhance scalable web applications using Java\-based backend services and modern React front\-end interfaces. You will work closely with product, QA, and DevOps teams to deliver secure, high\-performance features across the full software development lifecycle.
 



 Location \& Work Mode
 



 This role is based in Chennai, Tamil Nadu. \-WFO (All 5days)
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 • Design, develop, and maintain RESTful APIs and microservices using Java, Spring Boot, and related frameworks.
 



 • Build responsive UI components using React (Hooks, Context/Redux) and integrate with backend APIs.
 



 • Implement robust security practices including OAuth2/JWT, role\-based authorization, input validation, and secure coding guidelines.
 



 • Optimize application performance through profiling, caching strategies (e.g., Redis), efficient database queries, and asynchronous processing.
 



 • Write clean, testable code with unit/integration tests (JUnit, Mockito) and front\-end tests (Jest/React Testing Library).
 



 • Collaborate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, contribute to sprint planning, estimation, and technical design discussions.
 



 • Participate in code reviews, enforce coding standards, and mentor junior developers to improve overall code quality.
 



 • Support CI/CD pipelines, deployments, and production troubleshooting in partnership with DevOps/SRE teams.
 



 Required Skills \& Experience
 



 • 5–9 years of hands\-on experience in Java development with strong OOP and design patterns knowledge.
 



 • Strong experience with Spring Boot, REST API development, and microservices architecture.
 



 • Working experience with React (functional components, Hooks) and state management (Redux or Context API).
 



 • Experience with SQL and relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL) and ORM frameworks (Hibernate/JPA).
 



 • Understanding of messaging/async patterns (Kafka/RabbitMQ) and caching concepts (Redis) is a plus.
 



 • Proficiency with Git, build tools (Maven/Gradle), and CI/CD practices (Jenkins/GitHub Actions/GitLab CI).
 



 • Familiarity with containerization (Docker) and basic Kubernetes concepts is desirable.
 



 • Knowledge of Agile methodologies, code reviews, and engineering best practices.
 



 Education \& Certifications
 



 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred. Certifications such as Oracle Certified Professional (Java), AWS Certified Developer – Associate, or Spring Professional Certification are advantageous.

title: Tech Lead - Full stack
description:
**Career Area**
 Engineering
   

  

**Job Description**
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
 When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
   

  

****Job Description: Full Stack Tech Lead****
**Job Summary: Caterpillar Trimble Control Technologies (CTCT) is a joint venture between Caterpillar and Trimble whose purpose is to transform the way heavy equipment customers shape the world with solutions that differentiate Caterpillar and Trimble.**
**As a Full Stack Tech Lead for CTCT grade control platform products, you will own the end\-to\-end technical direction for your area — from HW/SW internals through system architecture to production release. You are the deepest technical voice in the room: you shape design and architectural decisions at the CTCT level, resolve the crises no one else can, and set the engineering bar the org treats as the benchmark. You translate complex business and system needs into robust software design, kill complexity that slows the org down, and drive AI\-Native, CI/CD, functional\-safety, and V\&V standards across EW/RW. Ultimately, your leadership ensures the product ships fast, ships safe, and holds a competitive edge on the field.**
**Job Duties \& Responsibilities**
**System \& Architectural Depth**
* CTCT\-Level Architecture: Make design and architectural decisions at the CTCT level with strong systems thinking, translating complex business and system requirements into robust software design.
* End\-to\-End Codebase Command: Hold a deep understanding of the entire EW/RW codebase and system\-wide flows — able to go into HW/SW internals and see the bits and bytes move across multiple features.
* First\-Principles Simplification: Cut architectural complexity and cost/BOM by deleting, not just adding — reducing designs to their essential parts and killing complexity that is slowing the org down.


**Debugging, Reliability \& Safety**
* Crisis\-Grade Debugging: Be the person who resolves any crisis, anywhere in the codebase or the field — including cross\-domain HW/SW issues others get stuck on — regardless of which team owns the code.
* Systemic Fixes: Put fixes in place that stop whole classes of bugs from recurring, not just one\-off patches.
* Reliability Standards Across Teams: Drive reliability and safety standards across EW/RW so the whole product fails safe.


**Delivery Governance, CI/CD \& AI\-Native Engineering**
* Release Governance: Represent your area in the CCB, make go/no\-go release\-blocker calls, and drive SDF, T\-Review, and release\-governance standards across teams.
* CI/CD at Scale: Tailor the SDF and design robust CI/CD across features; drive CI/CD standards and automation across EW/RW.
* AI\-Native Ways of Working: Set the AI\-Native patterns and guardrails others adopt — define prompt / agent standards and QC for AI output, and orchestrate and automate the build\-test\-deploy cycle with AI across teams.
* Velocity, Telemetry \& Data: Improve the team's build system and throughput, remove friction that slows the team down, drive observability across the product, and make decisions from data — not opinion.


**Technical Skills**
* Backend \- C\+\+ or relevant coding languages for backend
* Frontend \- Angular / React based front end designs.
* Communication protocols


**Posting Dates**
 September 18, 2026 \- October 1, 2026
   

  

 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply
   

  

 Not ready to apply? Join our Talent Community.

 We are looking for an experienced
 **Full Stack Developer with strong Python and Microsoft Azure expertise** 
 to join our engineering team building and scaling a
 **PCI DSS v4\.0–ready, microservices\-based order processing platform** 
 . This platform running on a secure, private\-network Azure architecture.
 



 You will work across the full stack — from API design and serverless compute to database design and CI/CD — building secure, cost\-efficient, and highly available services in a regulated, payment\-adjacent environment.
 



**What You'll Work On** 



* Design, build, and maintain
 **Python\-based microservices on Azure Functions** 
 (Python 3\.11/3\.12\) across domains such as order intake, customer management, catalog, orchestration, tax, payment/PCI, fulfillment, notifications, and support APIs.
* Build and secure APIs exposed through
 **Azure API Management (APIM)** 
 — including authentication, throttling, CORS, brand\-scoped RBAC, and correlation\-ID based tracing.
* Work within a
 **Private VNet architecture** 
 , integrating Function Apps, Private Endpoints, NSGs, and NAT Gateway–based outbound connectivity to third\-party partners (payment gateways, tax providers, OMS, email/mail services).
* Design and maintain schemas in a
 **shared Azure SQL Database** 
 using module\-owned table prefixes, optimizing for cost and performance at moderate transaction volume.
* Implement
 **secrets and credential management via Azure Key Vault** 
 using Managed Identity — ensuring no hardcoded credentials anywhere in the platform.
* Build
 **tokenized payment integrations** 
 (e.g., CyberSource/PayPal) ensuring PAN/CVV data never touches application code or storage — token\-only handling.
* Contribute to
 **PCI DSS v4\.0 compliance controls** 
 : network segmentation, encryption in transit/at rest, access logging, audit trails, and secure system design.
* Support
 **queue\- and timer\-triggered async processing** 
 (cron/orchestration patterns) for order lifecycle management with retry logic.
* Collaborate on
 **cost\-optimization decisions** 
 — right\-sizing Function plans (Elastic Premium), SQL tiers, and reserved capacity planning.
* Monitor and troubleshoot production systems using
 **Application Insights, Log Analytics, and Microsoft Defender for Cloud** 
 .
* Partner with stakeholders to translate deployment architecture and solution design into working, well\-tested code.



  





 Requirements
 



**What We're Looking For** 




**Required:** 



* 6–9 years of professional software development experience, with strong full\-stack capability.
* Deep hands\-on experience with
 **Python** 
 (3\.x) for backend/microservice development.
* Solid experience building and deploying on
 **Microsoft Azure** 
 , specifically:
* Azure Functions (serverless compute, VNet integration)
* Azure API Management
* Azure SQL Database
* Azure Key Vault \& Managed Identity
* Azure VNet, NSGs, Private Endpoints, NAT Gateway
* Experience designing
 **RESTful APIs** 
 and microservices architectures.
* Experience with
 **relational database design** 
 (schema design, query optimization, TDE/encryption\-at\-rest concepts).
* Understanding of
 **secure application design** 
 : secrets management, least\-privilege access, RBAC, TLS/encryption in transit.
* Familiarity with
 **asynchronous/queue\-based or timer\-based processing patterns** 
 .
* Experience integrating with
 **third\-party APIs** 
 (payment gateways, tax engines, OMS, email/notification providers, etc.).
* Working knowledge of
 **monitoring/observability tools** 
 (Application Insights, Log Analytics or equivalent).
* Strong understanding of
 **CI/CD pipelines** 
 and cloud deployment practices.



**Preferred / Nice to Have:** 



* Experience working in a
 **PCI DSS–regulated environment** 
 .
* Exposure to
 **e\-commerce order management systems** 
 (Shopify, OMS platforms, or similar).
* Experience with
 **tokenized payment processing** 
 (CyberSource, PayPal, Stripe, or similar gateways).
* Familiarity with
 **Infrastructure as Code** 
 (Bicep, ARM templates, or Terraform on Azure).
* Front\-end development experience (React/Angular/Vue) for full\-stack contributions beyond APIs.
* Experience with
 **cost optimization** 
 on cloud platforms (reserved capacity, right\-sizing).
* Azure certifications (e.g., AZ\-204, AZ\-400, AZ\-305\) are a plus.



**Soft Skills** 



* Strong ownership mindset — comfortable working across the stack from database to API to deployment.
* Ability to work in a security\- and compliance\-conscious environment with attention to detail.
* Clear communicator, able to work with architects and cross\-functional stakeholders.

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Title:** 
 AI/GenAI– Manager
   

  

**Educational qualification:** 
 BTech/Masters/PhD
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are seeking an experienced GenAI Manager with 10\+ years of overall experience, including significant hands\-on expertise in Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG architectures, Conversational AI, and enterprise AI platforms. The ideal candidate will lead the design, delivery, governance, and scaling of AI solutions while managing cross\-functional teams of AI engineers, data scientists, architects, and business stakeholders.
   

  

 The role requires a strong blend of technical leadership, solution architecture, AI strategy, delivery management, and stakeholder engagement to drive enterprise\-wide adoption of GenAI capabilities. The candidate should have proven experience delivering AI\-powered solutions such as RAG applications, AI agents, copilots, knowledge management platforms, AI automation workflows, and multi\-agent systems, while ensuring Responsible AI, quality, security, and scalability standards are met.
   

  

 The individual will lead AI quality, validation, and governance initiatives to ensure the reliability, security, performance, and scalability of enterprise AI and GenAI solutions while partnering with technical and business teams.
   

  

**Important:** 
 Hands\-on experience delivering AI solutions in enterprise or production environments is required. Certifications, personal projects, and demos alone are not sufficient.
   

  

**Application Guidance:** 
 Candidates should be able to explain at least two AI/GenAI implementations, including the business use case, their contribution, technical approach, and measurable outcomes.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the design, development, and delivery of enterprise AI, GenAI, Agentic AI, and RAG\-based solutions aligned with business objectives.

* Partner with engineering and business teams to define evaluation frameworks, quality standards, and performance metrics for AI systems.
* Guide the implementation of RAG architectures, knowledge management solutions, and agentic workflows to enhance business productivity and decision\-making.
* Manage stakeholder communication, executive reporting, budgeting, resource planning, and delivery governance for AI programs.
* Stay current with emerging trends in GenAI, Agentic AI, multimodal AI, AI agents, and enterprise AI platforms to drive innovation and competitive advantage.
* Contribute to capability building, reusable accelerators, reference architectures, and thought leadership across the AI practice.


**Skills and Attributes:**
**Professional Experience**
* 10\+ years of overall experience, including 5\+ years leading AI/ML, GenAI, or data\-driven transformation initiatives in enterprise environments.
* Proven experience delivering and scaling production\-grade AI, GenAI, Agentic AI, Copilot, and RAG\-based solutions from concept through deployment and adoption.
+ Strong understanding of enterprise AI architecture and hands\-on exposure to multiple areas, including:
+ LLM and GenAI application development
+ RAG architectures and knowledge management solutions
+ Agentic AI and multi\-agent systems
+ Conversational AI and Copilot solutions
+ AI evaluation, governance, and Responsible AI
+ AI platform engineering and cloud\-based deployments
+ MLOps / LLMOps and operationalization of AI solutions
+ Data engineering, vector databases, and retrieval pipelines

* Demonstrated ability to lead cross\-functional teams of AI engineers, architects, data scientists, and developers.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with experience translating business needs into scalable AI solutions and measurable business outcomes.
* Experience with enterprise AI platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, OpenAI, Databricks, Microsoft Copilot, and related AI ecosystems.


**Educational Background**
* Bachelor’s/master’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Engineering, or related field.


**Technical Skills**
* Strong understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, Agentic AI, Multi\-Agent Systems, and RAG architectures.
* Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise\-scale GenAI, Copilot, Conversational AI, and AI Agent solutions.
* Experience defining AI strategy, solution roadmaps, architecture standards, and operating models.
* Strong knowledge of AI platform ecosystems including Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Databricks, Vector Databases, and Enterprise Search platforms.
* Experience leading the design and implementation of RAG pipelines, knowledge management solutions, and AI\-powered business applications.
* Understanding of AI evaluation, guardrails, observability, quality metrics, and Responsible AI practices.
* Experience establishing governance frameworks covering AI security, privacy, compliance, safety, and risk management.
* Strong knowledge of prompt engineering, agent orchestration frameworks, tool integrations, and workflow automation.
* Experience managing the end\-to\-end AI lifecycle, including ideation, development, deployment, monitoring, and adoption.
* Proven ability to lead and mentor AI engineers, architects, data scientists, and cross\-functional delivery teams.
* Experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, cloud platforms, and business processes.
* Strong understanding of MLOps, LLMOps, model monitoring, performance optimization, and operationalization of AI solutions.
* Ability to work with executive stakeholders to identify AI opportunities, define business value, and drive adoption.
* Experience with enterprise architecture, software engineering best practices, scalability, reliability, and secure solution design.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills.


**Soft Skills**
* Excellent problem\-solving and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to translate AI capabilities into measurable business outcomes and enterprise value.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and executive presentation skills, with the ability to influence both technical and business audiences.


**Other Responsibilities:**
* Lead the delivery of enterprise GenAI, Agentic AI, and RAG solutions, from ideation through deployment and business adoption.
* Define AI strategy, solution roadmaps, governance frameworks, and best practices to drive scalable AI adoption.
* Partner with business and technology stakeholders to identify opportunities, prioritize use cases, and deliver measurable business value.
* Mentor and lead cross\-functional teams of AI engineers, architects, and data scientists, ensuring delivery excellence and innovation.
* Drive AI governance, Responsible AI, security, compliance, and operational readiness across all AI initiatives.


**Why Join Us**
* Be at the forefront of AI\-driven innovation across multiple client sectors.
* Work with global clients to drive real business impact.
* Collaborate with a team of AI experts, analytics leaders, and industry specialists in a highly entrepreneurial environment.


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**Company Overview**
 KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice\-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R\&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem\-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
   

  

**Group/Division**
 The KLA Services team headquartered in Milpitas, CA is our service organization that consists of Service Sales and Marketing, Spares Supply Chain management, Field Operations, Engineering, Product Training, and Technical Support. The KLA Services organization partners with our field teams and customers in all business sectors to maintain the high performance and productivity of our products through a flexible portfolio of services. Our comprehensive services include: proactive management of tools to identify and improve performance; expertise in optics, image processing and motion control with worldwide service engineers, 24/7 technical support teams and knowledge management systems; and an extensive parts network to ensure worldwide availability of parts.
   

  

**Job Description/Preferred Qualifications**
 KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice\-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays.
   

  

 The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and in 2019 we invested 15% of sales back into R\&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem\-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.

 The GSS organization's Engineering group develops data systems for improved diagnostics and predictive maintenance. The data systems monitor the performance of fleets of KLA test and measurement equipment in semiconductor fabrication plant environments. They collect, transform, and store data.
